1240: Deit leh chulaka beamma uveara kaddisha, yativ betzilla dimhemnuta, lekabbela ushepizin, lemechde behay alma uvealma deate uvae lemechde lemiskene. may taama. begin dechulaka deinnun ushepizin dezammin demiskene hu. vehahu deyativ betzilla da dimhemnuta, vezammin ushepizin illen illain, ushepize mehemnuta, vela yahiv lon chulakehon, kullehu kayyme minneh, veamre (Mishlei 23:6) al tilcham et lechem ra ayin vegomer, ishtechach dehahu patora detakkin, dileh hu, velav dekudesha berich hu, aleh ketiv (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem vegomer, peresh chaggechem, vela chaggay. vavy leh lehahu bar nash, beshaata deillen ushepize mehemnuta kayyme mippatoreh.

Veamar ribbi abba, avraham, kol yomoy hava kaim befarashat orchin, lezammena ushepizin, uletakkena lon patore, hasheta, dimzammenin leh, ulechullehu tzaddikayyay, uledavid malka, vela yahavin lon chulakehon, avraham kaim mippatora, vekare, (Bamidbar 16:26) suru na meal ohole haanashim harshaim haelle. vechullehu sallekin avatreh. yitzchak amar, (Mishlei 13:25) uveten reshaim techsar. yaakov amar, (Mishlei 23:8) pittecha achalta tekienna. ushear kol tzaddikayyay amre, (Yeshayahu 28:8) ki kol shulchanot malu ki tzoa beli makom.

David malka amar, (chaser kan) veashlim dinoy, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 25:38) vayhi kaaseret hayyamim vayyiggof Adonai et naval vayyamot. may ka mayyre. begin dedavid shaal lenaval, veitavid leh oshpiza, vela baa. veda zammin leh, vela yahav leh chulaka, uveinnun asara yomin dedavid malka dain alma, attedan aleh hahu bar nash deashlim leh bish yattir minaval.

Amar ribbi elazar (begin kach) orayyta la atrach aleh devar nash yattir, ella kema deyachil, dichtiv, (Devarim 16:17) ish kemattenat yado vegomer. vela lema inish echul veesba vearvivy bekadmita, uma deyishtear etten lemiskene, ella resha decholla deushepizin hu, vei chadde leushepizin veravvi lon, kudesha berich hu chadde immeh, veavraham kare aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai vegomer. veyitzchak kare aleh, (Yeshayahu 54:17) kol keli yutzar alayich lo yitzlach. amar ribbi shimon, hay, david malka amar leh, begin dechol zayynin demalka, ukeravin demalka, bidoy dedavid itpekadu, aval yitzchak kaamar, (Tehillim 112:2) gibbor baaretz yihye zaro vegomer, hon vaosher vegomer.

Yaakov amar, (Yeshayahu 58:8) az yibbaka kashshachar orecha vegomer, shear tzaddikayyay amre, (Yeshayahu 58:8) venachacha Adonai tamid vehisbia vegomer, david malka amar, (Yeshayahu 54:17) kol keli yutzar alayich lo yitzlach, deha hu al kol zeyne alma itpekad. zakkaa chulakeh devar nash, dezache lechol hay. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, bealma den, uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim vegomer. raya mehemna pikkuda (47) da litol lulav behahu yoma beinnun zinin dileh vehay raza okimna veokmuha chavrayyay kema dekudesha berich hu natil lon leyisrael behane yomin vechadde behon. uf hachi yisrael natle leh lekudesha berich hu lechulakehon vechaddan beh. veda hu raza delulav. uminin deveh deihu raza diyyukena deadam veha ittemar. (ad kan raya mehemana)

(Vayikra 23:40) ulekachtem lachem bayom harishon vegomer, ribbi shimon patach, (Yeshayahu 43:7) kol hannikra vishmi velichvodi berativ yetzartiv af asitiv. kol hannikra vishmi, da adam, dekudesha berich hu bara leh bishmeh (nusach acher bediukeneh), dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo. vekara leh bishmeh, beshaata deappik keshot vedina bealma, veikre elohim, dichtiv, (Shemot 22:27) elohim lo tekallel.

Kera leh bishmeh, dichtiv vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo veshappir. ha okimna, dichtiv naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu, beshaata deziuuga ittemar. vechach hu beziuuga detarvayyhu, betzelem udemut. veadam middechar venukeba nafak.
Vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo, besifra dishlomo malka ashkachna, divshaata deziuuga
1241: Ishtechach letatta, shadar kudesha berich hu chad diyyukena kefartzufa debar nash, reshima chakika betzulema, vekayyeyma al hahu ziuuga. veilmale ityeyhiv reshu leena lemecheze, chame bar nash al resheh chad tzulema, reshima kefartzufa debar nash, uvehahu tzulema itbere bar nash, vead dekayyeyma (sefer acher vead lo kayyeyma) hahu tzulema deshadar leh mareh al resheh, veyishtekach tamman, la itbere bar nash, hada hu dichtiv, vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo.

Hahu tzelem izdeman lokovleh, ad denafik lealma. kad nafak, behahu tzelem itrabbe, behahu tzelem azil, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 39:7) ach (Shemot 142 amud bet, 13 amud bet, 42) betzelem yithallech ish. vehay tzelem ihu milleella.

Beshaata deinnun ruchin nafkan meatrayyhu, kol rucha verucha ittakkan kamme malka kaddisha betikkune yekar, befartzufa dekaim behay alma. umehahu diyyukena tikkuna yekar, nafik hay tzelem. veda telitaa lerucha, veakdimat behay alma, beshaata deziuuga ishtechach. velet lacha ziuuga bealma, dela ishtechach tzelem begavvavyyhu. aval yisrael kaddishin, hay tzelem kaddisha, umeatar kaddisha ishtechach begavavyyhu. uleovde kochavim umazzalot, tzelem meinnun zinin bishin. missitra dimsaavuta ishtechach begavavyyhu. veal da, la live leh leinish, leitarva tzulema dileh, betzulema deovde avoda zara, begin dehay kaddisha, vehay misava. ta chaze ma ben yisrael uleovde kochavim umazzalot vechulei. (74 demalka dezammin ushepizin. ze hammaamar katuv befarashat vaychi yaakov daf 220 ammud 1 shura 1 0 veellu hacheylevapeym matzati ben hakkatuv behetek leven hakkatuv sham. shura 22 bemakom almin matzati tzulemin. shura 25 bemakom yaade dine geria. sham bemakom yadah matzati dina. shura 31 mi yitten erev veda kad nahara sihara velelya ittakkan binhora. shura 35 ovadin matzati biryayn. ammud 2 shura Adonai beh chela. shura 6 yetzartiv hayeynu vaanaf etz avot. af asitiv. shura 14 lecheru veal da karena leh yom harishon da besifra deaggadta veshappir hu. shura 24 deabba begin kach kolla yaa velo basima lapeyreyn velo avid perin. shura 25 haddin 120 teren. shura 26 levera davar acher. shura 29 yaakov 120 bera. shura 31 da beda 120 da belo da. shura 33 120 af al gav divhay nachal dina lo ishtechach beh. shura 35 120 detzaddik ibba vakenayshav ravreva nafke minnayyhu. shura 36 120 minnayyhu lo ibba velo tama. sham vecholla shappir veal da etrog bismala. uvesof hammaamar matzati katuv dichtiv).

Dichtiv (Bamidbar 29:35) bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem, deha yoma da, mimmalka hu bilchodoy, chedvavta dileh behu beyisrael. metal lemalka dezammin ushepizin, ishtedalu behu kol bene hechaleh, levatar amar malka, al ken ana veattun ishtaddalna kullehu beushepizin, ukeravtun karbenin al shear ammin bechol yoma, mikkan ulehala, ana veattun nechede yoma chad, hada hu dichtiv bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem. lachem: lekarva karbenin alayychu. aval ushepize mehemnuta, bemalka mishtachche tedira. uveyoma dechedvavta demalka, kullehu mitkannefe immeh, umishtachchan. veal da ketiv, atzeret, targumo: kenishu.

Vehay yoma, yaakov hu resha lechedvavta, vechol innun ushepize chadaan immeh. veal da ketiv, (Devarim 33:29) ashrecha yisrael mi chamocha. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar.

(Vayikra 24:2) veyikchu elecha shemen zayit zach katit lammaor vegomer, amar ribbi elazar, ha ukemuha. aval amay asmich kudesha berich hu parasha da, lefarashat moadim. ella, kullehu butzinin illain, kullehu butzinin leadleka meshach revut illaa, veha ittemar. veal yedayyhu deyisrael, mitbarchan illain vetattain, veadliku butzinin, kema deukemuha dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev, chedvavta
1242: Ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 32:11) simchu baAdonai vegilu tzaddikim, (simchu baAdonai kema deat amar) uchetiv, (Tehillim 118:24) ze hayyom asa Adonai nagila venishmecha vo. veokmuha, deha bekudesha berich hu (nusach acher bamevaadaya) bae lemechde, uleanhara anpin, veyishtechach bar nash bechedva, begin dehahu chedva dekudesha berich hu havi, dichtiv nagila venismecha bo beyoma. bo: bekudesha berich hu, vecholla chad milla.

Simchu baAdonai, kad dinin itkafyayn, verachame itaru, vechad mitare rachame, keden vegilu tzaddikim, (ketiv) tzaddik vetzedek mitbarchan kachada, deikrun tzaddikim, kema deittemar, deha illen mitbarchan (sefer acher mevarchin) lealmin, vechadan lealmin kullehu. vehareninu kol yishre lev, illen bene mehemnuta, leitkashshera behu.

Uvecholla, bae ovada letatta, leatara leella. ta chaze, man deamar dela baya ovada becholla, o millin leappaka lon ulemebad kala behu, tifach rucheh. veha hacha parsheta da ochach, adlekut butzinayya, uketoret busemin, (kachada begin) dichtiv shemen uketoret yesamach lev. (uvehay) uveovada da ishtechach adlekuta leella vechedvavta letatta (sefer acher adelakevatea vechedvavta leella vetatta) veitkashsheruta kachada kedka yeot. (uveovada diltatta ittear ovada dilella) amar ribbi yehuda, mizbeach diltatta, atar mizbeach ochora. kohen diltatta, atar kohen ochora. beovada diltatta, atar ovada leella.

Ribbi yose veribbi yitzchak havo azle beorcha, amar ribbi yose leribbi yitzchak, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad vegomer, vechibbadto measot derachecha shappir. aval mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar ma hu. umay geriuta hu leshabbat.

Amar leh, vaday geriuta hu, delet lach milla umilla denafik mippumeh debar nash, delet lah kala, vesalleka leella, veitar milla ochora. umay hu. hahu deikre chol, (leella) meinnun yomin dechol. vechad itar chol beyoma kaddisha, geriuta hu leella vadday. vekudesha berich hu ucheneset yisrael shaale aleh, man hu devae leafresha ziuuga dilan. man hu devae chol hacha. attika kaddisha la itchaze, vela sharya al chol.

Begin kach, hirhur muttar. may tama. begin dehirhur la avid midi vela itavid minneh kala, vela salik. aval levatar deappik milla mippumeh, hahu milla itavid kala, uvaka avirin urekiin, vesalleka leella, veitar milla ochora. veal da mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar ketiv. uman deappik milla kaddisha mippumeh, milla deorayyta, itavid minneh kala, vesalik leella, veitaru kiddushe malka illaa, umitatteran beresheh, ucheden ishtechach chedvavta leella vetatta.

Amar leh, vday hachi hu. veha shemana milla. aval man deshari betaanita beshabbeta, avid geriuta leshabbat, o la. i tema dela avid geriuta, ha seudate dimhemnuta batil minneh, veonsheh sagi, ha chedvavta deshabbat batil minneh.

Amar leh, milla da shemana, deda hu deashgechan aleh milleella, mikkol bene alma. begin dehay yoma, chedvavta hu leella vetatta. chedvavta dechol chedvavn. chedvavta, dechol mehemnuta beh ishtechach. vaafillu reshaim degehinnam nayychin behay yoma. vehay bar nash let leh chedva, velet leh nayycha, veshanya da mikkol illain vetattain. kullehu shaalin aleh, may shanya diflanya hu betzaara.

Uveshaata deattika kaddisha itgele behay yoma, veishtechach hay betzaara, tzeloteh salleka vekayyeyma kammeh, keden itkerau kol gizre dinin deitgezaru aleh, vaafillu istekamu beve dina demalka aleh levish, kolla itkera, begin divshaata deattika itgalyay, kol cheru vechol chedu ishtechach, begin deitgalyay behillula demalka.

Veal da tanenan, korin lo gezar dino shel shivim shana. man shivin shana. ella af al gav deaskimu aleh kol innun shivin kitre malka, dehu itchaze behu, kolla itkera. begin deattika kaddisha natil (sefer acher batil leh vehane) leh lebar nash, vehane
1243: Mile, kad mitare aleh bechelma belelya deshavta.

Lemalka daaved hilula livreh, vegazar chedva al kolla. behay yoma dehillula, kol alma havo chadan, uvar nash chad hava atziv, tafis bekulera. ata malka lechedvavta, chama kol amma chadan kema deihu gazar. zakaf enoy, chama hahu bar nash tafis bekulera atziv. amar, uma kol bene alma chadan behillula divri, veda tafis bekulera. miyyad pakid venafke leh, veshaaru leh mikulereh. (sefer acher mikkitroy)

Kach hay deshari betaanita beshabbeta, kol alma chadan, veihu atziv, vehay itpas bekulera. beshaata deattika kaddisha itgalyay behay yoma, veishtechach hay bar nash tafis bekulera, af al gav deaskimu aleh kol innun shivin shenin deamaran, kolla itkera, vela share aleh dina. beyoma ochora it beh reshu lemikra leh, behahu yoma, kol shekken shabbat.

Delet lach yom dela ishtechach beh chela, uman deshari betaanita dechelma behahu yoma, la salik hahu yoma ad dekara dineh. aval lav deshivim shana keyoma deshabbat. begin kach, behahu yoma mammash, vela beyoma ochora, delet reshu leyoma al yoma ochora. kol yoma, ma deira beyomeh, avid. dela ira beyomeh, la avid. veal da la live leh leeynash lesalleka leh miyyoma da leyoma ochora. uvegin kach, devar yom beyomo tanenan, vela devar yom leyoma ochora.

Veta chaze, lav lemagana mitare aleh bechelma, begin lemitba aleh rachame. vavy lehahu bar nash dela mitare aleh, vela odu leh bechelma, deha ikre ra. uvegine kach, (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) lo yegurecha ra ketiv. uchetiv (Mishlei 19:23) bal yippaked ra, bal yippaked, begin deihu ra.

Amar ribbi yose, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:13) mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar, kevan dichtiv mimmetzo cheftzecha, mahu vedabber davar. ella, ad deyigzar milla kedka yeot, vimallel leh. vaday kach hu berira demilla, mashma dichtiv vedabber davar. zakkain innun yisrael bealma den uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv, (Yeshayahu 63:8) vayyomer ach ammi hemma banim lo yeshakkeru vayhi lahem lemoshia.

(Vayikra 24:10) vayyetze ben ishsha yisreelit vehu ben ish mitzri vegomer. vayyetze, ribbi yehuda amar, nafak mikkelala dechulaka deyisrael, denafak mikkelala decholla, nafak mikkelala dimhemnuta. vayyinnatzu bammachane, mikkan olifna, kol man deate mizzuhama dezara, lesof galyay leh kamme kolla. man garim leh, zuhama dechulaka bisha deit beh. delet leh chulaka bichlala deyisrael.

Ribbi chiyyay patach, (Mishlei 25:2) kevod elohim haseter davar uchevod melachim chakor davar. kevod elohim haseter davar, delet reshu levar nash legallaa millin setimin, dela itmesaru leitgalyay. millin dechafa lon attik yomin, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 23:18) leechol lesava velimchasse atik. leechol lesava, ad hahu atar deit leh reshu vela yatir. veim kol da, velimchasse atik, limchasse atik vadday.

Davar acher, leechol lesava, innun chavrayyay deyadin archin ushevilin lemehach beorach mehemnuta kedka yeot. kegon dara deribbi shimon share begavih. velimchasse atik, middarin ochoranin deha kullehon la itchazun leechol ulesava uleitgalyay millin begavavyyhu, ella limchasse atik, kema deat amer, (Kohelet Adonai:Adonai) al titten et picha lachati et besarecha.

Beyomoy deribbi shimon, hava bar nash amar lechavreh, petach picha veyairu devarecha. batar deshachiv, havo amre, al titten et picha vegomer. beyomoy, leechol lesava. batar deshachiv, velimchasse atik. dechavrayyay megamgeme, vela kayyme bemillin. davar acher, leechol lesava: beinnun millin deitgalleyayn. velimchasse atik: beinnun millin deitchappeyayn.
1244: Vayikkov ben haishsha hayyisreelit et hashshem, mahu vayikkov. ribbi abba amar, vayikkov vadday, kema deat amer, (Melachim 2 12:10) vayyikkov chor bedalto, nakiv ma dehava satim. veshem immo shelomit bat divri, ad kan satim shema deimmeh, kevan dichtiv vayikkov, nakiv shema deimeh.

Amar ribbi abba, i lav devutzina kaddisha kayyeyma bealma, la arshena legallaa, (mikkan vahala) deha la ityeyhiv milla da legallaa ella lechavrayyay, deinnun ben mechatztzede chakla (dei lav). tippach ruchehon deinnun deatyayn legallaa, leinnun dela yade.

Ta chaze, ketiv vayyinnatzu bammachane ben hayyisreelit veish hayyisreeli, hay kera ha okimna, aval da bar intu ochora daavoy, balah dishlomit hava. vechevan deata hahu mitzraa alah, befalgut lelya, tav leveta veyada milla, itperash minnah vela ata alah. venatal intu ochora, veolid lehay, veikre ish hayyisreeli, veochora ben hayyisreelit. i innun intzu hacha kachada, may ka bae hacha shema kaddisha. vaamay killel shema kaddisha.

Ella, ish hayyisreeli amar milla meimmeh, miggo ketata. miyyad vayyikkov ben haishsha hayyisreelit. kema deat amer, vayyikkov chor bedalto. raza demilla, natal Adonai dishma kadisha, velayit, leaggana al immeh. veda hu nekiva, deihu nakiv ufarish shema kadisha. velimchatzde chakla ittemar. veraza demilla, (Mishlei 30:20) ken derech ishsha menaafet vegomer, zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, deyadin milla, umechasseyayn lah. veal da ittemar, (Mishlei 25:9) rivcha riv et reecha vesod acher al tegal.

Adonai batraa, havat nukeba deyanka bitren sitrin, begin kach natla zayynin demalka, venakmat nikmaha, dichtiv hotze et hamekallel. al da ketiv, ish immo veaviv tirau, dechilu deimma akdim leabba. vezakkain innun yisrael bealma den uvealma deate.

(Vayikra 24:15) veel bene yisrael tedabber lemor ish ish ki yekallel elohav venasa cheto. ribbi yehuda amar, ha ukemuha. aval ki yekallel elohav satim. uvegin deamar elohav setam, lechach venasa cheto. deha la yadenan man hu elohav, man dachala dileh, i echad min hassarim, o chad min kochvayyay, o chad middavare alma.

Amar ribbi yose, i tzaddik gamur hu, la yitar (sefer acher milla) chelehon, vechevan deitar milla da, chayyshinan minut izderikat beh, vela yemut (sefer acher amar rabbi yose, afillu tzaddik gamur lo yamut) al da, begin deihu milla satim.

Ribbi yehuda amar, dain leh letav beha, dei amar elohay, yachil lemitan elohay dehava ad hashsheta, deitmashkena avatreh belibbai, vehasheta ahadarna lokovla mehemnuta illaa. aval i amar Adonai elohim, o Adonai, venakiv leh bishma, hay let leh lemitan behay, begin deda hu mehemnuta decholla, vechol at veat (92 amud bet) dishma kaddisha da, salleka lishma shelema. (sefer acher leshabbecha)

Davar acher vayyikkov ben haishsha hayyisreelit et hashshem vaykallel. ribbi yitzchak amar, vayyikkov ben haishsha, amay. ella kema deukemuha. aval haish hayyisreeli, balah dishlomit hava. ribbi yehuda amar, bereh devalah dishlomit meintu ochora hava. amar ribbi yitzchak, natzu kachada, veamar leh milla meimeh, vechi avoy hava deitketal bishma kadisha, kema deukemuha dichtiv (Shemot 2:14) halehargeni atta omer, deha bishma kaddisha, katil leh moshe, veal da oshit milla lokovleh.

Veda hu dichtiv, vayyikkov ben haishsha hayyisreelit et hashshem vaykallel vayyaviu oto el moshe. amay. (sefer acher legabbeh demoshe begin dekatil laavuhi vechulei) begin demata legabbeh demoshe, al dekatil laavuhi bishma kadisha. begin kach vayyaviu oto el moshe. kevan dechama moshe, miyyad vayyannichuhu bammishmar, veabba uvera naflu bida demoshe.

(Vayikra 24:15) ish ish ki yekallel elohav venasa cheto. ribbi yitzchak patach, (Tehillim 81:9-10) shema ammi veaida bach yisrael im tishma li lo yihye vecha el zar velo tishtachav leel nechar, kevan dichtiv lo yihye vecha el zar, may velo tishtachav leel nechar.
1245: Ella lo yihye vecha el zar, dela yeul bar nash leyetzer hara begavih, dechol man deate leitchabbera beh, el zar sharya begavih, deha kad itchabbar bar nash beh miyyad ate leabera al pitgame orayyta, ate leabera al mehemnuta dishma kaddisha, veate levatar lemisgad letaavavn ochoran, veal da ketiv, lo yihye vecha el zar, kevan dela yihye vecha el zar, la tete lemisgad letaavavn ochoran, ulemebar al mehemnuta dishma kaddisha. hada hu dichtiv, velo tishtachav leel nechar, umehemnuta bisha debar nash da hu.

Veal da ki yekallel elohav, deyachil lemitan dehu layit lehahu el zar, yitzra bisha desharya aleh lezimnin, vaanan la yadinan milloy i keshot o lav. veal da, venasa cheto. aval venokev shem Adonai mot yumat.

Amar ribbi yehuda, i hachi, amay venasa cheto, venislach cheto mibbae leh. (sefer acher ella) amar leh, kegon deamar elohay kema deokimna setam, vela parish. ribbi chiyyay amar, ki yekallel elohav setam, vela perash, veha vadday venasa cheto. aval venokev shem Adonai mot yumat, deha hacha talyay mehemnuta decholla, velet leh reshu lemitan aleh kelal.

Amar ribbi yose, hachi hu vadday, deha shema da mehemnuta deillae vetattae. veal da kayymin almin kullehu, beat chad zeera, talyayn elef alfin veribbo rivvan almin dechissufin, veal da tanenan, atvavn illen, keshirin illen beillen, vechamma elef rivvan illain (sefer acher almin), talyayn bechol at veat, veisteliku veitkashsharu bimhemnuta (beitgalleyay) vesatim behu, ma dela itdavaku illain vetattain, orayyta behu talyay, alma den vealma deate, hu ushemeh chad. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 39:2) amarti eshmera derachay mechato vilshoni. uchetiv (Kohelet Adonai:Adonai) al titten et picha lachati et besarecha.

Ribbi chizkiyya patach, (Shemot 19:13) lo tigga bo yad ki sakol yissakel o yaro yiyyare im behema im ish lo yichye bimshoch hayyovel. uma tura desinay, deihu tura kishar ture alma, begin deitchaze aleh yekara demalka kaddisha, ketiv lo tigga bo yad ki sakol yissakel o yaro yiyyare, man dekariv lemalka la kol shekken. uma tura desinay deyachil bar nash leoshit beh yada orach yekar bidchilu, ketiv lo tigga bo yad setam, vaafillu beorach yekar. man deoshit yedeh beorach kelana lokovel malka, la kol shekken.

Ribbi yesa patach veamar, (Shemot 3:Adonai) al tikrav halom shal nealecha meal raglecha ki hammakom asher atta omed alav admat kodesh hu. uma moshe, demin yoma deityelid zihara kadisha illaa la ade minneh, ketiv beh al tikrav halom. amar leh, moshe, ad kan la ant keday leishtammesha bikari, shal nealecha. uma moshe kach, dehava kariv bidchilu bikdushsha ketiv beh hachi. man dekariv beorach kelana legabbe malka, al achat kamma vechamma.

Ribbi abba amar, ish ish ki yekallel elohav venasa cheto. ta chaze, kad havo yisrael bemitzrayim, havo yade beinnun ravreve alma, dimmanan al shear ammin, vechol chad vechad hava leh dachala bilchodoy minnayyhu. kevan deitkesharu bekishra dimhemnuta, vekariv lon kudesha berich hu lefulechaneh, itperashu minnayyhu ukarivu legabbe mehemnuta illaa kaddisha. uvegin kach ketiv, ish ish ki yekallel elohav, veaf al gav defulechana nucheraa hu, kevan daana pakidat lon memana ledabbera alma man delayit umevazze lon, venasa cheto vadday, deha birshuti kayymin veazle umadberin bene alma. aval venokev shem Adonai mot yumat, lav venasa cheto kema leillen, ella mot yumat. mot bealma den, yumat bealma deate. leillen venasa cheto, begin dimvazze ovade yedoy, mevazze leshammashay daana pakidit, veasir hu, aval mita la itchayyayv behu.
Rabbi shimon hava azil bearcha, vahava immeh ribbi elazar veribbi abba veribbi chiyyay veribbi yose veribbi yehuda matu lechad tikle demaya, pusekra ribbi yose bekatpoy lego mayya, amar
1246: Kutera dekusete demayya ulevay la shechiach. amar leh ribbi shimon, asir lach. shamsha dealma hu, veasir leanhaga kelana beshamsha dekudesha berich hu vechol shekken deinnun ovade keshot, benimuse dekistira illaa shechiche.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 1:31) vayyar elohim et kol asher asa vehinne tov meod. vayyar elohim et kol asher asa, setam, afillu nechashim veakrabbim vittushim, vaafillu innun deitchazun mechabbele alma, bechullehu ketiv vehinne tov meod kullehu shammashe alma, madbere alma, uvene nasha la yade.

Ad dahavo azle, chamu chad chivya madbar kammayyhu, amar ribbi shimon, vadday da azil learchasha lan nisa, rahat hahu chivya kammayyhu, vekatar bechad efe bekitra deorcha satun (sefer acher natzan) chad bechad umitu. kad matun, chamu lon letarvavyyeyhu shechivin bearcha. amar rabbi shimon, berich rachamana derachish lan nisa. deha kol man deistakkal behay, kad ihu bekiyyumeh, o ihu yistakkal bebar nash, la yishteziv vadday, kol shekken i yikrav bahadeh. kara aleh, (Tehillim 91:10) lo teunne elecha raa venega lo yikrav beoholecha. uvecholla avid kudesha berich hu shelichuta dileh, velet lan leanhaga kelana bechol ma deihu aved. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 145:9-10) tov Adonai lakkol verachamav al kol maasav, uchetiv, yoducha Adonai kol maasecha. (nidpas vaychi 221)

Ribbi shimon patach, (Shir HaShirim 2:1) ani chavatztzelet hashsharon shoshannat haamakim. kamma chaviva keneset yisrael kamme kudesha berich hu, dekudesha berich hu meshabbach leh, vehi meshabbachat leh tadir. vechamma shevachin umazmmerin atkenat leh lemalka tadir. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, daachidan beadva dechulaka kaddisha, kema dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.

Ani chavatztzelet hashsharon, da keneset yisrael, deikre chavatztzelet, dekayyeyma bishpiru denoy beginta deeden leitnattea. hashsharon, dehi (natrat nusach acher sara) umashbachat leh lemalka illaa. davar acher ani chavatztzelet hashsharon, devaya leishtekaa mishshakyu denachala amika, mabbua denachalin. kema deat amer (yeshaya log) haya hashsharon (chaareva). (laagam mayim) shoshannat haamakim, dekayyeyma (Bereshit 221 amud alef) beamikta decholla.

Shoshannat haamakim. man innun amakim. kema deat amer (Tehillim 130:1) mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai. chavatztzelet hashsharon, mehahu atar deshakyu denachalin amikin nafkin, vela paskin lealmin. shoshannat haamakim, shoshannat dehahu atar deikre amika decholla, satim mikkol sitrin.

Ta chaze, bekadmita chavatztzelet yeroka, betarpin yerokin levatar shoshanna, bitren gavvnin sumak vechivvavr. shoshannat: beshit tarpin. shoshannat: deshaniat gavvnaha, veishteniat miggavvna legavvna. shoshannat, bekadmita chavatztzelet, bezimna devaya leizdavvevga beh bemalka, ikre chavatztzelet. batar deitdavakat beh bemalka, beinnun neshikin, ikre shoshanna. begin dichtiv (Shir HaShirim Adonai:13) siftotav shoshannim. shoshannat haamakim. dehi shanyayt umashniat gavvnaha, zimnin letav, vezimnin levish. zimnin ledina, vezimnin lerachame.

(Bereshit 3:6) vattere haishsha ki tov haetz lemaachol vechi taava hu laenayim vegomer. ta chaze, deha bene nasha la yadin, vela mistakkelin, vela mashgichin, beshaata devara kudesha berich hu laadam, veokir leh beyakiru illaa, baa minneh leitdabbeka beh, begin deyishtechach yechiday, uvelibba yechiday, uvaatar didvekuta yechidaa, dela yishtane vela yithappech lealmin, behahu kishshura dimhemnuta yechidaa, decholla beh itkeshar. hada hu dichtiv veetz hachayyim betoch haggan.

Ulevatar satu meorcha dimhemnuta, veshavku ilana yechidaa illaa mikkol ilanin, veatu leitdabbeka baatar demishtane umithappech miggavvna legavvna, umitav levish, umibbish letav, venachtu meella letatta, veitdevaku letatta beshinnuyin saggiin, veshavku illaa decholla, dehu chad, vela ishtanne lealmin. hadda hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:29) asher asa haelohim et haadam yashar vehema vikshu chishshevonot rabbim. vehema vikshu chishshevonot rabbim vadday, keden ithappach libbayyhu behahu sitra mammash, zimnin letav, zimnin levish, zimnin lerachame, zimnin ledina.
1247: Kehahu milla deitdevaku bah vadday. vehema vikshu chishshevonot rabbim, veitdevaku behu.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, adam, shavkat chayye, veitdabbekat bemota. chayye, dichtiv veetz hachayyim betoch haggan, etz deitkere chayyim, deman deachid beh, la taim taama demota lealmin. veitdabbekat beilana ochora, ha vadday mota hu lokovlach. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:Adonai) ragleha yordot mavt vegomer. uchetiv (Kohelet 7:26) umotze ani mar mimavt et haishsha. vadday baatar demota itdevak, veshavak atar dechayye, begin kach itgezar aleh veal kol alma mota.

I hu chata, kol alma may chatu. i tema dechol biryayn atu veachlu meilana da, veitreme mikkolla. lav hachi, ella beshaata deadam kaim al ragloy, chamu leh biryayn kullehu, vedachalu mikkammeh, vahavu natlin batreh, keavdin kamme malka. vehu amar lon, ana veattun, (Tehillim 95:6) bou nishtachav venichraa nivrecha lifne Adonai osenu, vechullehu atu batreh. kevan dechamu deadam sagid lehay atar, veitdabbak beh, kullehu itmeshachu avatreh, vegarim mota leh, ulechol alma.

Keden ishtanne adam lechamma gavvnin, zimnin letav, zimnin levish. zimnin rugeza, zimnin nayycha. zimnin dina, vezimnin rachame. zimnin chayye, zimnin mota. vela kaim bekiyyuma tadir bechad minnayyhu. begin dehahu atar garma leh. veal da ikre, lahat hacherev hammithappechet, min sitra da, lesitra da, min tav levish, min rachame ledina, min shalom lekrava, ithappichat hi lecholla. veikre tov vara, dichtiv umeetz haddaat tov vara lo tochal mimmenu.

Umalka illaa, rachama al ovade yedoy, ochach leh, veamar leh umeetz haddaat tov vara lo tochal mimmennu, vehu la kabbil minneh, veitmeshach batar itteteh, veittarach lealmin. deha itteta laatar da salleka, vela yattir. veitteta garim mota lecholla.

Ta chaze, lealma deate ketiv, (Yeshayahu 65:22) ki chime haetz yeme ammi. chime haetz: hahu etz deishtemoda. beh zimna ketiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) bila hammavt lanetzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen.
1248: Keden kudesha berich hu ishtechach ben tzaddikayyay, ukkeneset yisrael meshabbachat leh lekudesha berich hu, ad deate tzafra. kevan deate tzafra, ishtechachu mishtayan beraza chada. veit lah nayycha bevalah. hada hu dichtiv, al mokda al hammizbeach kol halayla vegomer. ad habboker, deha betzafra dinin veshalhovin ishtechachu, ucheden ittear avraham bealma, venayycha hu decholla.

Ta chaze, kevan dealu yisrael leara, la ishtechachu bah dinin tattain, ukkeneset yisrael havat bah benayycha, al kanfe dichruvim. kema deittemar, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 1:21) tzedek yalin bah. keden havat lah nayycha mikkolla. deha yisrael la nayymin, ad dimkarve karbena deven haarbayim, veisteliku dinin. veola hava ittokad al madbecha, ucheden hava lah nayycha mikkolla, vela ishtechach ella itteta bevalah, hada hu dichtiv ki tavou vegomer veshavta haaretz, nayycha vadday. (Vayikra 25:2) veshavta haaretz shabbat laAdonai, shabbat laAdonai mammash.

Tu patach ribbi elazar, (Shemot 21:2) ki tikne eved ivri shesh shanim yaavod vegomer. begin dechol bar yisrael deitgezar, deit beh reshima kaddisha, it leh nayycha bishmitta. deha dileh hu hahu shemitta, lenayycha beh. veda ikre shabbat haaretz, vday cheru it bah. nayycha bah, kema deshabbat nayycha hu decholla, hachi name shemitta nayycha decholla, nayycha hu derucha vegufa.

Ta chaze, Adonai nayycha hu deilae vetattae. begin kach, Adonai illaa, Adonai tattaa. nayycha deillain, nayycha detattain. Adonai illaa, sheva shanim sheva peamim. Adonai tattaa, sheva shanim bilchodayyhu. da shemitta, veda yovla.

Vechad mistakkelin mille kolla chad. begin kach veshavta haaretz, behahu nayycha deara, itzterichu avdin nayycha. uvegin kach, uvashsheviit yetze lachafshi chinnam. chinnam, mahu chinnam. dela yahiv lemareh kelum.

Ella da raza, hacha olifna, ketiv (Bamidbar 11:5) zacharnu et haddaga asher nochal bemitzrayim chinnam, bela beracha. dela hava alana bemitzrayim ol dilella. ta chaze, avadin peturin meol malchuta dilella, veal da peturin min hammitzvot. may ol malchut shamayim. ella, kehay tora deyahavin aleh ol bekadmita, begin leappaka minneh tav lealma. vei la kabbil aleh hahu ol, la avid midi. hachi name itzterich leh lebar nash lekabbela aleh ol bekadmita, ulevatar deyiflach beh bechol ma deitzterich. vei la kabbil aleh hay bekadmita, la yechul lemiflach.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 2:11) ivdu et Adonai beyira. mahu beyira. kema deat amer (Tehillim 111:10) reshit chachma yirat Adonai. veda malchut shamayim. uvegin kach ol malchut shamayim. veal da hay bekadmita hu decholla. man ochach. tefilla, bekadmita shel yad. begin divhay ayel lishar kedushsha. vei hay la ishtechach legabbeh, la sharya beh kedushsha leella, begin kach (Vayikra 16:3) bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh vegomer ketiv.

Vehay ol la sharya, beman deihu kafit beochora. veal da avadin peturin meol malchut shamayim. vei mehay ol peturin, mikkol shear peturin. deha shear la sharya aleh debar nash, ad deishtechach gabbeh behay ol. uvegin kach havo achle yisrael bemitzrayim chinnam. uf hacha yetze lachafshi chinnam. deha avda hava, vechol ma deavid, chinnam hu, bela ol malchut shamayim. veaf al gav dechinnam havo ovadohi yetze lachafshi, vihe leh nayycha.

Levatar deihu becheru, veishtechach beh nayycha, yahavin aleh ol, mehahu atar deappik leh lecheru. vei bar nash yesarev lemeppak lecheru, kema deat amer veim amor yomar haeved ahavti et adoni vegomer. ha vadday pagim leh lehay atar, deshavik ol malchuta dilella, venatil ol demareh. veal da ma ketiv, vehiggisho adonav el haelohim vehiggisho el haddelet vegomer. vehiggisho adonav el haelohim. el haelohim setam. legabbe hahu atar defagim leh dehachi name elohim ikre.
Ulean atar yitkeriv legabbeh. el haddelet o el hamezuza.
1249: Begin dehay atar pitcha hu dilella, umezuza ikre, veha ittemar. vechevan deihu achvvavn leafgama lehay atar, hahu pegimu ishtear bahadeh beh begufeh hada hu dichtiv, veratza adonav et azno bammartzea vaavado leolam. yeheve avda techot ragloy demareh, ad shatta deyovla.

Et azno amay. ha okmuha. aval shemia tale behay atar, asiyya leella. uvegin deyisrael kad kerivu letura desinay, vahavu birchimu delibbayyhu leitkarva lekudesha berich hu, akdimu asiyya lashshemia, deha shemia bekadmita, ulevatar asiyya. shemia behay shemita talya. veal da hu pagim lehay shemia, yitpegim shemia dileh, veyishtear pegimu beh. vela yishtear hu avda lemareh, ad deyitkarev lehahu atar defagim, veyitpegim hu kammeh, veyishtear beh hahu pegimu. uvegin kach, vehiggisho adonav el haelohim setam, kema deokimna. veal da, veshavta haaretz shabbat laAdonai.

(Vayikra 25:4) shesh shanim tizra sadecha vegomer, uvashshana hashsheviit shabbat shabbaton yihye laaretz shabbat laAdonai. veha okmuha, dichtiv, (Shemot 23:11) uvashsheviit tishmetenna unetashtah vegomer. may tama veachlu evyone ammecha. begin demiskene behay atar talyayn, uvegin kach shavik lon lemechal. veal da, man derachim lemiskena, yahiv shelama bichneset yisrael, veosif birchata bealma, veyahiv chedu vechela laatar deitkere tzedaka, learka birchata lichneset yisrael, veokimna.

Raya mehemna uvashshana hashsheviit shabbat shabbaton vegomer. pikkuda da lishbot bashshana hashsheviit vaavatreh lishbot bashshevii. vaavatreh lehashemit kesafim bashsheviit. vaavatreh limnot sheva shanim sheva peamim vehayu lecha yeme sheva shabbatot hashshanim tesha vearbaim shana. hacha raza dechol sheviiyyot, missitra dishchinta deitkeriat sheva missitra detztzaddik deihu shevii labbina, veihi bat sheva, missitra deima illaa, deittemar bah (Tehillim 119:164) sheva bayom hillalticha.

Sheva shemahan innun avgitatz, uvehon 42 atvavn, kelal atvavn vetevin hem tesha vearbein, imma illaa shenat hachamishshim shana, devah ukeratem deror. bah tehe shechinta tattaa, deror pedut ushevita leyisrael, deittemar behon (Bereshit 28:14) vehaya zaracha kaafar haaretz.

Kol sefira meillen sheva, shit gadfin, deinnun shit atvavn lechol chad. uvehon kudesha berich hu (ushechinteh) bechol sefira meillen sheva, (Yeshayahu 6:2) bishtayim yechasse panav uvishtayim yechasse raglav uvishtayim yeofef, uvina ihu achat, ushechinta tattaa sheva. uleella mibbina, achat veachat, ha eser sefiran. shetayim, 3, ved, vaAdonai, vev, vez.

Kan vayyilech haloch vegadel. missitra nucheraa, vehammayim hayu haloch vechasor, ematay. baatar dishchinta tattaa sharya bez. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 8:4) vattanach hatteva bachodesh hashevii, da shechinta tattaa. beshiva asar yom lachodesh, ihi sheviaa vaasiraa.

Dislikat behon ehye, deihi bina, shenat hayyovel, ihi ehye asher ehye, teren zimnin ehye chusheban 42, utemanyya atvavn behon chamshin. divhon pikkuda lachashov shenat hayyovel. uveh pikkuda lachazor laachuzato bayovel, bishnat hayyovel hazot tashuvu vegomer. kol chad yachazor beh ledarga dileh, denishmateh achiza mittamman, kema deokmuha (Kohelet 12:7) veharuach tashuv el haelohim vegomer.

Shemita: shechinta tattaa, deihi mishsheva shenin. yovel: imma illaa, bina, ihi lechamshin shenin. uvah ityaychasin yisrael bemafkanutehon min galuta. hada hu dichtiv, veish el mishpachto tashuvu. kegavvna demafkanu demitztzerayim deinnun mare tora bah, ittemar behon (Shemot 13:18) vachamushim alu bene yisrael, veokmuha echad mechamishim.

Ushechinta tattaa, ihi geulat bate are choma ittemar bah, uvate are hachatztzerim. ditre batte it belibba, im innun mimare tora, itkeriu bate are choma, kegavvna deittemar bemafkanu demitztzerayim, (Shemot 14:22) vehammayim lahem choma miminam
1250: Umissemolam. laacherim, delav innun mare tora itkeriu batte hachatztzerim.

Amar ribbi shimon, veha ashkachna chatztzerim deittemar beh (Ester Adonai:1) vattaamod bachatztzar bet hammelech happenimit nochach bet hammelech. uvechol atar hammelech setam, da kudesha berich hu. vattaamod, en amida, ella tzelota. nochach bet hammelech: nochach bet hammikdash, dechol yisrael tzerichin letztzallaa tzelota dilhon letaman, ulemehevi nochach bet hammikdash. hacha man chatztzar happenimit. vadday teren innun chatztzerot bet Adonai.

Amar leh butztzina kaddisha, teren chatztzerim, innun chitztzoniyyim delibba, veinnun teren aznaym delibba. uteren battim penimiyyim, teren batte delibba. uteren innun batte gooe, uteren innun bate barae. uvezimna diyhe purekana, geula tehe lechullehu leinnun kerivin lelibba, deihu shechinta, uleillen rechikin deitkerivu, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 57:19) shalom shalom larachok velakkarov, veokmuha larachok meavera, velakkarov mimmitztzeva.

Behahu zimna, pikkuda litkoa shofar terua bayovel, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 18:3) kinso nes harim tiru vechitkoa shofar tishmau. kegavvna devitkiat shofar deyovla, kullehu avdin nafke lecherut, hachi befurekana batrayyta, bitkiat shofar, mitkanneshin kol yisrael mearba sitre alma, deinnun avdin deyovla. demare tora, it behon avdin al menat lekabbel peras, veitkeriu avde malka umatronita. aval benoy demalka kaddisha, (Shemot 19:4) vaessa etchem al kanfe nesharim vaavi etchem elay, deinnun gadpe chevavn demerkavta.

Pikkuda batar da, latet lalleviyyim arim lashavet. uvegin deinnun la ishtattafu baegla, kudesha berich hu chalak lon legabbeh. lemehevi menaggenin leh bechamma mine niggun. dechohanim baavodatan, uleviyyim leshiram ulezimram, veyisrael linvihem. kohanim baavodatam, deit tamman kama pikudin.

Pikkuda chad, laasot shemen hammishcha. 2, leviyyim shomrin bamikdash. 3 yisrael lira min hammikdash. 4, avodat halleviyyim bevet hammikdash. Adonai, lehaketir ketoret paamayim. 6, kohanim tokim bachatztzotztzerot bamikdash. 7, lekaddesh zera aharon bamikdash. 8, lilbosh bigde kehuna bamikdash. 9, rechitztzat yadayim veraglayim, laavod bamikdash.

10, Lihyot hakkohanim osim karbanot bamikdash. 11, lifdot pesule hamukedashin. 12, karban hayyoledet bayom hashshemini. 13, limloach karbanot bamikdash. 14, laasot haola kemishpatah. 15, laasot hachatat kemishpato. 16, achilat kodashim kamishpat lakkohanim. 17, achilat sheyyare menachot. 18, laasot menachot kemitztzevavtan. 19, lehavi karbanot levet hammikdash. 20, lehavi neder o nedava levet hammikdash. 21, lehavi karbanot kodashim temurot uveladot. 22, lehakeriv shene temidin kehilchatan. 23, lehadelik esh tamid al hammizbeach.

24, Laasot terumat haddeshen. 25, lehadelik nerot hammenora. 26, lehakeriv mincha bechol yom. 27, lehakeriv musaf beshabbat. 28, lehasedir lechem ulevona. 29, lehakeriv karban musaf berosh chodesh. 30, lehakeriv bez yeme happesach. 31, lehakeriv beyom haomer keves leola. 32, lehakeriv (karban) haomer. (hayeynu sefirat haomer) 33, lehakeriv karban musaf beshavuot. 34, lehakeriv shete hallechem beshavuot. 35, lehakeriv musaf berosh hashshana. 36, lehakeriv musaf beyom hakkippurim. 37, lehakeriv musaf bez yeme hechag. 38, lehakeriv musaf bishmini atztzeret. 39, lisrof et hanotar baesh. 40, lisrof kodashim shenitmau. 41, laavod kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim.

42, Hammoel bahekdesh keren vachomesh. 43, (sefer acher lehavi hachote karban chattat al chatu) karban chatat. 44, asham taluy al sefeko. 45, karban asham vadday, al hayyadua. 46, karban ole veyyored. 47, karban sanheddere gedola shetau. 48, lehakeriv hazzav achar sheyitaher. 49, karban zava achar shettitaher. 50, karban yoldot. nusach acher, karban metztzoraim, mittamman veelach shear pikudin.

Mare metivtan, beomaa alayychu, la tadu minni, ad deatkin karbenin lekudesha berich hu. dishchinta ihi karban laAdonai, bechol ever veever demalka, bechibbura shelim, bidchar venukeba. bechol evarim, deinnun: minnehon beresha, ayynin beayynin. udenin
1251: Legabbe udenin. chotama bechotama. anpin beanpin. puma befuma. kegon (Melachim 2 4:34) vayyasem piv al piv veenav al enav. uveda hava mechayye hayyeled. vehachi yedin demalka, im yedin dematronita, gufa begufa, bechol evarim dileh. karbena shelim.

Debar nash bela itteta, palgu gufa ihu, ushechinta la sharya aleh. hachi (sefer acher kad) kudesha berich hu, lav ihu bekarbena im shechinta, bechol yisrael, deinnun anshe middot, deinnun evarim dilah. illat haillot la sharya tamman, ucheillu la hava kudesha berich hu chad, batar delav ihu im shechinteh. uvechutztza laaretz dishchinta merachaka min balah, ittemar kol haddar bechutztza laaretz, dome kemi sheen lo eloah. begin delet tamman karbenin bechutztza laaretz. ulezimna dekudesha berich hu mitkarev im shechinteh, itkayyaym beh hay kera, (Zecharya 14:9) bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. veillat haillot sharya alayyhu.

Af al gav detakinu avahan tzelotin baatar dekarbenin. hay ihu lekarva nafshin veruchin venishmatin deinnun sichliyyim lekudesha berich hu ushechinteh. keevarin legabbe gufa aval missitra dechuresyayn umalachin, deinnun gufin veevarin, dilvar mimmalka umimatronita, let tamman karbena. uvegin da ittemar bechuresyyay, (Shemot 17:16) vayymer ki yad al kes yah. (kes, chaser meches 1) (nusach acher 11 chaser mishsham 26) (Yirmeyahu 17:12) kisse kavod marom merishon mekom mikdashenu. veevarin beferuda min gufa. ihu lego, veinnun levar. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:7) hen erellam tzaaku chutztza, chutztza vadday.

Yehe raava dilach, leachzera lan leve makdesha, lekayyem tzelota deokmuha kadmae, yehi ratztzon millefanecha Adonai elokenu viloke avotenu shettaalenu vesimcha leartztzenu vetitaenu bigvulenu vesham naase lefanecha et karbanot chovotenu temidin kesidran, kol chad besiddura dileh, umusafin kehilchatan. dichan levar meara deyisrael, let tamman karbenin, kegufin divria, dekudesha berich hu ushechinteh, missitra daatztzilut dileh, let tamman piruda veafrashuta. dishchinta ihi yichudeh, uvirchateh, ukedushateh. vela itkeriat gufa, ela kad itgashmu bechuresayayn, umalachin divria, kenishmata deitlabbesha begufa shefala. uvegin da, kad shechinta ihi levar mehechala deve makdesha, ulevar mikkuresyayn dilah, kivyachol keillu la hava chad immeh.

Missitra dechisse elyon deihu gufa lekudesha berich hu, umalachin detalyayn minneh, keevarin detalyayn min gufa, deinnun dechurin. venishmatin deitgezaru mineh dechurin. kisse tinyayna, gufa dishchinta, vechol nishmatin detalyayn minneh, nukevin. umalachin detalyayn mehahu kuresyay, nukevin. ukarivu dilhon bekudesha berich hu ushechinteh.

Hachi yichud kudesha berich hu ushechinteh, af al gav deinnun kenishmatin legabbe kuresyay umalachin, hachi innun legabbach illat haillot, kegufa, deant hu dimyayched lon, umekarev lon, uvegin da emuna dilach behon, veant let alach nishmeta, detehevi ant kegufa legabbah, deant hu neshama lanshamot, velet neshama alach, vela elaha alach, ant levar mikkolla, ulegav mikkolla, ulechol sitra, uleella mikkolla, uletatta mikkolla. velet elaha ochora, ella vetatta, umikkol sitra, umilgo deeser sefiran, deminnehon kolla, uvehon kolla talya veant bechol sefira, bearka verachbah, ella vetatta, uven kol sefira usefira, uveovi dechol sefira usefira.

Veant hu dimkarev lekudesha berich hu ushechinteh, bechol sefira usefira, uvechol anfin dinhorin detalyayn minnehon, kegarmin, vegidin, veor, uvasar, detalyayn min gufa. veant let lach gufa, vela evarim, velet lacha nukeba. ella echad bela sheni. yehe raava dilach, ditkarev ant shechinta legabbe kudesha berich hu, bechol dargin deinnun atztzilut dilah, deinnun nishmatin devaale middot. nesie yisrael. chachamim. nevonim. chasidim. gibborim. anshe emet. neviim. tzaddikim. melachim. kullehu daatztzilut. deit ochoranin divria.

Dishchinta ihi karban, shemen hammishcha. mimina shemen lammaor, kegon (Bereshit 1:16) et hammaor haggadol. shemen mishchat kodesh ihu missitra dismala, deittemar bah vekiddashta et halleviyyim. shemen katit, ihi missitra detztzaddik, deihu katish ketishin meevarin deinnun zetim, leachata mishcha legabbi petila. petila techla. ugevura mittamman ihi yira, uleviyyim shomrin hammikdash.

Umittamman pikkuda lira min hammikdash, veihu mitztzevat avodat halleviyyim bamikdash bechd mishmarot leviyyim divhon leviyyim beshira uvezimra havo mezammerin kodamach, lesalleka shechinta deihi shira vezimra behon laAdonai. 24 im shira vezimra 26, kechushevan Adonai. vaavatreh pikkuda ihi mitztzevat ketoret tamid lekudesha berich hu, uketoret kekarbena.
Vehifshit et haola venittach otah lintacheha. veemurin ufedarin deinnun mitakkelin kol hallayla,
1252: Innun kappara deevarin degufa dileh venafsheh, dela yittokdun begehinnam, vela yitmasserun bida demalach hammavt, uvegin debar nash chav beyitztzer hara, deihu tzefoni, hachi shechitato batztzafon leshezava leh mehahu tzefoni.

Uvekarbenin, tol behu kal vachomer minviim, deaf al gav detora ihi shem Adonai, unevua deittemar bah (yeshaya 63) ruach Adonai tenichenu. im kol da, lav kol mare tora shekilin, velav kol neviim shekilin, deit neviim, dinvua dilhon bilvushin demalka, vehachi hu orayyta debal pe, kama mare sefekot uferukin, bilvusha demalka.

Veit ochoranin desallekin yattir, beevarim degufa demalka, deittemar behon vaere, veraiti, bamare, beayynin. (Chavakuk 3:2) Adonai shamati shimacha yareti, bishmia. yechezkel istakkeluteh uneviuteh meayynin. chavakkuk meuddenin bishmia. uvegin da, yechezkel chaza kol illen marot demerkava biriyay, been hassechel. chavakkuk, bishmia. veit nevia dinvuateh befuma, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 6:7) vayyigga al pi. nevua ochora merecha dechotama, hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 2:2) vattavo vi haruach. veit dinvuateh beyad, hada hu dichtiv, (Hoshea 12:11) uveyad hanneviim adamme. veacharanin lifnim bechayyi hammelech, veochoranin lifnay lifnim.

Vehachi beorayyta, peshatim, reayot, derashot, sodot desitre tora, uleella sitre setarim laAdonai hachi bekarbanin af al gav dekarbanin kullehu laAdonai, ihu natil kolla, ufalig karbanin lemashiryayn dileh. minnehon palig lakkelavim, inun karbanin pesulin, deyahiv lehon lesamael kelev, ulemashshiryayteh. uvegin da hava nachit diyyukena dechalba. uminnehon leshedim, deit behon kiviran, uminnehon kemalache hashsharet, uminnehon kivne nasha. leinnun deovadehon kasheddim, palig karbanehon lashedim.

Illen deovadehon kemalachin, palig karbanin dilhon lemalachim, hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 28:2) et karbani lachmi leishshay. deinnun karbanin dilhon, lav talyayn biviran. dekarbanin diviran, innun deamme haaretz. innun karbenin (demalachin) divne nasha, tzelotin veovadin tavin. karbanin detalmide chachamim, mare middot, illen mare raze deorayyta, vesitrin genizin divhon, kudesha berich hu nachit hu begarmeh, lekabbela karbanin dilhon, deihi torat Adonai temima, shechinta kaddisha, me middot.

Vetalmide derabbanan, innun millin dilhon kaachilat sheyare menachot, veit ochoranin demitgabberin alayyhu, deorayyta dilhon kaachilat menachot atztzeman, vela sheyare menachot. veit ochoranin deorayyta dilhon achilat kodashim, maachalim mikkamma minin lemalka. vechol menachot demaachalin dekarbanin, manne kudesha berich hu lekarva leh kullehu beveta dileh, deihi shechinta. vehay ihu pikkuda lekarva karbanot bevet habbechira, lekayyem (Yirmeyahu 9:23) ki im bezot yithallel hammithallel vegomer.

Lemalka dahavo avdoy vaafarkesoy veshuletane malchuta shalche leh kama dorone, amar, man devae lemishlach li dorona, la yishllach ella beyada dematronita, lekayyem bah (Tehillim 103:19) umalchuto bakkol mashala. uvegin da itkeriat shechinta karban laAdonai, ola laAdonai, asham laAdonai, vaafillu karban niddot veyoldot umetztzoraim vezavim vezavot, kolla tzarich lekarva laAdonai, ushechinteh, ulevatar ihi feligat lecholla hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha, vaafillu mezona dechevavn, kegon karban seorim maachol beiran, umaachal avadim ushefachot deve malka, vaafillu dechalve udechamare ugemalle, lekayyem bah umalchuto bechol mashala. umenalan deal yedaha palig kolla, dichtiv vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha.
Begin dekudesha berich hu ben 15, 6 ben 15, kalil Yahu. ushelimu dileh Adonai, ihi ola laydod. karban laydod. shelamim laAdonai. kerivu dileh, shelimu dileh, deveh ashlim Yahu, lemehevi Adonai.

Vecholla ithaddar beh, uvegin da (Shemot 22:19) zoveach laelohim yochoram, bilti laydod levaddo, dela yahiv shuletanuta lesitra ochora bekarbana, dechol elohim acherim alma deferuda innun, velet lon keriva veyichuda, vekudesha berich hu afrish lon mishshemeh, kegon deafrish choshech meor, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:4) vayyavdel elohim ben haor uven hachoshech. uman dekariv lekudesha berich hu ma deafrish, keman dekariv mesaavu denidda levalah, vehay ihu raza (Vayikra 18:19) veel ishsha beniddat tumeatah lo tikrav legallot ervatah.

Vehay lo tegalle ervatan, keruv, dechol eryayn shekilin leavoda zara, dechol sitrin ochoranin, alayyhu ittemar, (Bereshit 10:Adonai) meelle nifredu iyyi haggoyim beartztzotam. uchetiv lilshonotam beartztzotam begoyehem. uchetiv ki sham balal Adonai sefat kol haaretz umishsham hefitztzam Adonai. vechol man dekariv shum karbana lesitrin ochoranin, kudesha berich hu afrish leh mishshemeh, velet leh chulaka bishmeh. dekudesha berich hu bachar lon leyisrael mikkol shear umin, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 14:2) uvecha bachar Adonai. ufalig lon minnayyhu lechulakeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32) ki
1253: Uvegin da yahiv lon orayyta mishshemeh. (Shemot 3:15) ze shemi leolam veze zichri ledor dor, veha ukemuha 15 im shemi, 365. 11 im zichri, 248. bechol mitztzeva umitztzeva, kashir lon leyisrael bishmeh, lemehevi kol ever veever dilhon, chulak adveh veachasanteh. uvegin da zoveach laelohim yochoram vegomer.

Tzerichin yisrael leshattefa laAdonai, bahalicha dilhon, behakitz dilhon. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 6:22) behithallechcha tanche otach beshachbecha tishmor alecha vahakitztzota hi tesichecha. kam hahu talmida veishtetach kammeh, veamar zakkaa ihu chulakeh, deman dezache lemishma millin illen, kullehu shem Adonai bechol sitra, vela nafik minneh levar bechol sitroy. (ad kan raya mehemana) (29 amud alef pikkuda lehakeriv vechulei)

(Vayikra 25:20) vechi tomru ma nochal vegomer, ribbi yehuda patach, (Tehillim 37:3) betach baAdonai vaase tov shechan eretz uree emuna. leolam bar nash yehe zahir bemareh, vidabbek libbeh bimhemnuta illaa, begin dihevi shelim bemareh. dechad yehevi shelim beh, la yachlin leavasha leh kol bene alma.

Ta chaze, betach baAdonai vaase tov, may vaase tov. ella hachi taninan, beovda diltatta, yitar ovda dilela. veha ukemuha, vaasitem otam, kivyachol, attun taavdun lehon, begin divhahu ataruta dilchon deattun avdin letatta, itar leella veal da vaase tov ketiv, veen tov, ela tzadik, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov. kevan deattun avdin hay, vday hay tov yitar, keden shechan eretz uree emuna, vecholla chad.

Shechan eretz, eretz illaa. deha let lach bealma, deyachol lemishre bahadah, ad deyitar hay tov legabbah, kevan deyitar leh, kivyachol hu avid leh, ucheden shechan eretz, shere begavvav, echul eva, ishtasha bahadda. uree emuna, da eretz vechola chad kema deat amer (Tehillim 92:3) veemunatcha ballelot. uree emuna, havi dabbar lah bechol reutach.

Vei la tittear lokovlah, hay tov itrechak minnah, vela tikrav bahadah, la tikrav lego attun nura yakidta, vei tikrav bahadah, bidchilu, keman dedachil min mota. deha keden nura dalik, veokid alma veshalhovoy. vechevan deitar lokovlah hay tov, keden, share begavvav, vela tidchal minnah ant, keden, (Iyov 22:28) vetigzar omer veyakam lach veal derachecha nagga or.

Ta chaze, bene mehemnuta madbere lehay lirutehon bechol yoma. man innun bene mehemnuta. innun demitare hay tov lokovleh, vela chas al dileh, veyade deha kudesha berich hu yahiv leh yatir. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 11:24) yesh mefazzer venosaf od. may taama. begin dehay itar birchan lokovleh, vela yemma i etten hay hasheta, may abid lemachar. ella kudesha berich hu yahiv leh birchaan ad beli day, kema deukemuha.

Uvegin kach, vechi tomru ma nochal bashshana hashsheviit vegomer, ma ketiv. vetzivviti et birchati lachem bashshana hashshishshit veasat et hattevua lishlosh hashshanim. veasat, veasta mibbae leh, may veasat. ella leappaka Adonai, deit lah shemitta venayycha, vela avid avidta. ketiv (Shemot 16:29) reu ki Adonai vegomer noten lachem bayyom hashshishshi lechem yomayim vegomer, kegavvna da vetzivviti et birchati lachem bashshana hashshishshit vegomer.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havo azle bearcha, pagu behahu tura, ashkachu tere gavre dahavo azle, addehachi chamu chad bar nash dehava ate, veamar lon, bematu minnayychu, havu li mezona pitta denahama, dehane teren yomin detaina bemadbera, vela achalna midi. ishtemit chad meinnun tere gavre, veappik mezoneh deihu ayyte leorcha, veyahiv leh, veachil veashke leh. amar leh chavreh, ma taavid min mezona, deha ana didi achalna. amar leh, ume ale didach, ana azil, yativ gabbeh hahu miskena, ad deachal kol ma dehava gabbeh, vehahu nahama deishtear, yahav leh leorcha, veazal leh.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, la baa kudesha berich hu demilla da yitavid al yedan. amar ribbi yose dilma dina itgezar al hahu bar nash, uvaa kudesha berich hu lezammena kammeh hay, begin leshezava leh. ad dahavo azle, laa hahu gavra beorcha, amar leh chavreh, vela
1254: Amena lach dela titten nahama leochora. amar ribbi chiyyay leribbi yose, ha mezona gabban nihav leh lemechal. amar ribbi yose tive lemeppak minneh zechuta, nezil venechome, deha vaday bekafture deda tifsa demota itachid, uvaa kudesha berich hu lezammena zechuteh, begin leshezveh.

Addehachi, yativ hahu bar nash, venaim techot chad ilana, vechavreh itrechik minneh, veyativ bederech ochora. amar ribbi yose leribbi chiyyay, hasheta netiv venechome, devadday kudesha berich hu bae lemirchash leh nisa, kamu veorichu. addehachi chamu chad tifsa beshalhove kaim gabbeh. amar ribbi chiyyay, vavy al hahu bar nash, dehashta yaymut. amar ribbi yose, zakkaa hahu bar nash, dekudesha berich hu yarchish leh nisa. addehachi nachat meilana chad chivya, uvaa lemikteleh. kam hahu tifsa aleh vekatleh. kistter beresheh tifsa, veazal leh.

Amar ribbi yose, vela amena lecha dekudesha berich hu baa lemirchash leh nisa, vela tippuk zechuteh minneh. addehachi ittear hahu bar nash, vekam veazil leh. achidu beh ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose, veyahavu leh lemechal. batar deachal, achviu leh nisa derachish leh kudesha berich hu.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Tehillim 37:3) betach baAdonai vaase tov shechan eretz uree emuna, zakkaa chulakeh devar nash deavid tov middideh, deha ittear tov bichneset yisrael. uvemma. bitzdaka. dechad ittear tzedaka, hu tov keden ittear legabbe keneset yisrael. veal da ketiv (Mishlei 10:2) utzedaka tatztzil mimmavt. may tama. begin ditzdaka ilana dechayye hu, veittear al hahu ilana demota, venatil innun daachidan beh, vesheziv lon min mota. man garim lehahu ilana dechayye deittear lehay, havi ema hahi tzedaka deihu avid, kivyachol hu avid leh leella, kema deat amer (tehillim 110) ose tzedaka vechol et. veha ittemar.

Raya mehemna (Vayikra 25:46) vehitnachaltem otam livnechem vegomer, leolam bahem taavodu vegomer. pikkuda da laavod beeved kenaani, dichtiv, leolam bahem taavodu veinnun missitra decham degalle eryayn deittemar aleh (Bereshit 9:25) arur kenaan eved avadim yihye leechav. amay eved avadim. ella eved lehahu eved olam, deihu olamo shel yovel. vei tema deha achuha deshem veyefet hava, amay la hava hachi kevavtayyhu. vehachi mizzara decham hava eliezer eved deavraham, amay la hava kevavteh, denafak tzaddik, vekudesha berich hu ode bevirchateh, kad barich leh lavan.

Ella vadday hacha beraza degilgula, golel or mippene choshech, avda deavraham denafak mechoshech, veda zara decham, dayo leeved lihyot kerabbo deihu avraham, denafak mitterach oved avoda zara. vechoshech mippene or, da yishmael denafak meavraham, veesav miyyitztzechak.

Veraza taarovet tippin, baatar delav dileh garim da. man deariv tippa dileh, beshifcha machalat bat yishmael, o bevat el nechar, deinnun ra choshech, vetippa dileh tov or, (Bereshit 1:3-4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. mearev tov im ra, avar al memra demareh, deamar (Bereshit 2:17) umeetz haddaat tov vara lo tochal mimmennu.

Kudesha berich hu, behahu deirev (202), arkiv leh, veayyte leh begilgula lekabbela onsheh. chazar betiyyuveta, ishtaddal beorayyta, veafrish tov mera, deinnun asur vehetter, tumea vetohora, kasher ufasul. beda itperash ra mitov, deittemar beh vayyitztzer, yetztzira letav, vitztzira levish. beorayyta afrish lon, kudesha berich hu yarit leh nishmeta minneh, lemehevi shalta al tarvavyyhu, bechad deihu or. alma deate. uvechad deihu choshech, alma den. hada hu dichtiv vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim.

Uchefum zachvavn vechovin. kema deukemuha, haose mitztzeva achat metivin lo. benoni, zachvavn vechovoy shekilin, palgu zachvavn leella (sefer acher vapelagev letatta) ufalgu chovoy letatta, veraza da (Ester Adonai:6) ma sheelatech veyyinaten lach uma bakkashatech ad chatztzi hammalchut veteas. tzaddik gamur, kol zachvoy leella, vechovoy letatta. rasha gamur, chovoy leella, vezachvoy letatta.
Ubbar nash dechav beitgalyay, bitren dargin ihu, i chazar betiyyuveta beitgalyay, ben tzaddikayyay,
1255: Begin deyadin dinoy dekudesha berich hu, venatrin garmayyhu millemechete. uveitkasseyay, ben rashiayyay, lekayyem behu (Iyov 11:20) veene reshaim tichlena.

Uvegin da, chova deadam avar, al (Bereshit 2) vaytztzav Adonai elohim, veokmuha, en tzav ella avoda zara, abar aleh, arkiv leh betippat terach, deveh ratach lekudesha berich hu, deavar al tzav meavoda zara. haddar betiyyuveta, vetavar tzulemin deavoda zara, vechol mezone dileh. hu takkin bema dechav, vetavar chova, uvinyayna bisha devana, veamlich leh lekudesha berich hu ushechinteh. al alma.

Bemay. begin dekaddish shemeh yitberach barabbim, veal benura leittokda garmeh. lekayyem beh (Devarim 7:25) pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh. velo od ella dilavoy terach ahdar betiyyuveta, veail leh uleimmeh, ulechol mare dehahu dara began eden. vehachi itlabban benura kechaspa, deihi monita demalka, veshiker lah beoferet, ail leh benura, venafak haoferet levar, yishmael. uvegin da nafak, metztzachek beavoda zara. veishtear adam melubban, vehay ihu shinuy hashshem. dechad itgalgal adam, bae lemebad leh shinnuy hashem, shinnuy makom, veshinnuy maase.

Levatar ata yitztzechak, veittekaf beh, mechova tinyayna, deittemar beh al haadam, deda shefichut damim, veda garam nisyona deyitztzechak besakkina. veitbarar beh, keman devarir ochel miggo pesolet, venafik pesolet levar, esav shofech damim.

Levatar ata yaakov, vearkiv leh belavan, veitavid eved legabbeh, hada hu dichtiv. (Bereshit 29:18) eevadcha sheva shanim berachel. uvehahi sibba deachlaf lah baachota, avad sheva shanim ochoranin. leappaka teren tippin dezarak adam baatar nucheraa, veda giluy arayot, vehay ihu lemor. veappik lon min lavan haarami, nachash.

Uvitlat illen, hava leadam shinnuy hashem, veshinnuy makom, veshinnuy maase. shinnuy hashem: beavraham. veshinnuy makom: beyitztzechak. veshinnuy maase: beyaakov. vei lehay deittemar beh, (Iyov 28:27) az raah vaysapperah, kibbel betiyyuveta kol shekken laacherim.

Uvegin da, eved tov atra garim. veeved ra, uf hachi. aval shear avadim, leolam bahem taavodu. kamu mare metivta, veamru (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo, shekkacha begimatriya moshe. kam raya mehemana veamar, ashre haam sheAdonai elohav. (ad kan raya maheymea) (mishpatim 117 lo tihye achare rabbim vechulei)

(Vayikra 25:55) ki li vene yisrael avadim vegomer. pikkuda laavod bechol mine avoda bamikdash, ulevar mimmikdash, bechol innun pulechanin deikre avoda, bitzlota, leishtaddela batar pikkude orayyta decholla ikre avoda, keeved deishtedal batar mareh, bechol ma deitzterich.

Begin deyisrael kare lon avadim, dichtiv ki li vene yisrael avadim avaday hem. may taama innun avadim. begin dichtiv asher hotzeti otam meeretz mitzrayim. uvegin kach ketiv beeser amiran levatar, dichtiv (Shemot 20:2) anochi Adonai elohecha asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim, lemiflach leh keeved defalach lemareh defarik leh min mota, defarik leh mikkol bishin dealma.

Bitren zinin (nusach acher shemahan illen) ikrun yisrael lekudesha berich hu, avadim, dichtiv avaday hem. veikrun banim, dichtiv (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. bezimna deyada leh bar nash lekudesha berich hu beorach kelal, keden ikre eved deavid pikkuda demareh, velet leh reshu lechappesa begnizoy uverazin deveteh. bezimna deyada leh bar nash beorach perat, keden ikre ben rechima dileh, keven dechafis bignizoy, bechol razin deveteh.

Veaf al gav deikre ben bera buchera lekudesha berich hu, kema deat amer (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael, la yippuk garmeh mikkelala deeved, lemiflach laavuy bechol pulechanin deinnun yekara daavoy. vehachi itzterich lechol bar nash lemehevi legave avoy ben, lechappesa bignizoy uleminda razin deveteh, uleishtaddela avatrayyhu. ulemeheve legabbe avoy eved.

Veraza demilla, teren dargin innun leella, deitzterich bar nash leitattera behu, veinnun raza dimhemnuta, veinnun chad. chad, raza deeved. vechad, raza deven. vehay eved, ikre adon kol haaretz. ben, kema deokimna beni vechori yisrael. vecholla raza chada dimhemnuta. veitzterich bar nash leitatra beillen dargin, leitkallela beraza dimhemnuta.

Eved, lemiflach bechol zine pulechana, bitzlota deikre avoda, kehay eved deihu raza illaa, dela shachich lealmin tadir. veka meshabbecha umenaggena tadir. veha ittemar befulechanin ochoranin, dechol pulechanin umillin dealmin kullehu ihu avid ufalach. uvegin da ikre adon, begin deihu eved lemiflach, ikre adon kol haaretz. bar nash deitattar beraza
1256: Da, lemehevi eved lemiflach pulechaneh demare, ihu salik veitattar lemehevi bedarga da, veikre uf hachi adon, deha ihu barich bechol innun pulechanin, lehay alma, vekiyyem leh. veal da ikre adon. (sefer acher adoni haaretz).

Zakkaa chulakeh dehay ben, dezache leishtaddela leminda beginze deavoy, uvechol razin deveteh, kivra yechiday deashleteh avoy bechol genazoy, veda ihu yekara, deshallit al kolla man deyishtedal beorayyta, leminda leh lekudesha berich hu. uveinnun genizin dileh, ikre ben lekudesha berich hu, kol chele shemaya, let man deyimche bideh, bechol shaata deitzterich lemeal legabbe avoy. zakkaa chulakeh bealmin kullehu. uvegin da, kad ishtaddal leminda leh beorach perat, beraza dechachmeta, keden ikre ben.

Befulechana debar nash palach leh lekudesha berich hu, it pulechana, deitzterich bar nash leitkallela betarvavyyhu, lemehevi eved uven, leitattera beh bekudesha berich hu. uma ihu. da pulechana ditzlota, deitzterich lemehevi bah eved uven, leitkallela bedargin illain illen. lemiflach uleatkena tzelota beraza deeved, lemiflach pulechana detikkuna dealmin. uleitdabbeka reuteh berazin dechachmeta, leitdabbeka bemareh bignizin illain kadka chaze.

Ben itdevak tadir baavoy bela piruda kelal, let man deyimche bideh. eved, avid pulechana demareh, veatkin tikkune alma. man dahavi tarvavyyhu bichlala chada, bechibbura chada, da ihu bar nash deatkin raza dechol mehemnuta bichlala chada, bela piruda kelal, umechabber kolla kachada. da ihu bar nash, dekudesha berich hu achriz aloy bechol illen chayyaylin umashiryayn dechol almin, uvechol innun rekiin, izdeharu biflanya mehemana deve malka, dechol ginze demareh bideh. zakkaa ihu behay alma, vezakkaa ihu bealma deate.

Mehahu yoma ulehala, ishtemoda bar nash, veitreshim bealmin kullehu. beshaata deitzterich kol chelin umashiryayn kullehu izdeharan lemehevi gabbeh, vekudesha berich hu la bae ella ihu bilchodoy. vekala ittear, yeot hu leyyachid lemehevi gabbeh deyachid, uleitasseka yachid beyachid.

Veraza ditren dargin illen, ashkachna bechad kera, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar. vayyomer li avdi atta, ha eved. yisrael ha ben. dechad innun kelala chada, keden ketiv asher becha etpaar. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen. (Shemot 134 amud bet pikkuda lilmod tora)
1257: Kudesha berich hu la avid lan keovadana.

Ta chaze, balak chakkim hava, verav charshin beovade yedoy, yattir min bilam. vehachi olifna kol ma devae bar nash behay alma befulechana dekudesha berich hu, bae leitteara beovada letatta. divovada diltatta, ittear ovada leella, veovada da bae bikdushsha, veha ukemuha. uvaatar delet ovada, it milla, uvemilla defuma, talya ovada, leitteara leella. kema devaenan leitteara kedushsha illaa, beovada uvemilla. hachi name innun deatyayn missitra dimsaavuta, bayayn leitteara sitra dilhon, beovada uvemilla defuma.

Veaf al gav devilam charsha hava rav mikkol charshin dealma, charsha illaa minneh hava balak. bekesem hava balak rav mikkol chakkimin. uvilam benachash (veha ukemuha). kesem venachash teren dargin innun, kesem talya beovada. nachash la talya beovada ella beistakkeluta, uvemilla defuma. ucheden mitarin alayyhu rucha misava, leitlabbesha behu, veavid ma deavid.

Veyisrael kaddishin lav hache, ella kullehu kaddishin, vechol ovadayyhu leitteara alayyhu rucha kaddisha. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 32:15) ad yeare alenu ruach mimmarom. veal da ketiv, (Bamidbar 23:23) ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael, deha innun besitra dikdushsha illaa achidan. veovadayyhu bikdushsha atu, ukedushsha mitare alayyhu umitlabbeshan bah.

Veta chaze, bekesem hava balak rav mikkol chakkimin, uvilam benachash. veal da beshaata devaa balak leitchabbera immeh, ma ketiv (Bamidbar 22:7) vayyelchu zikne moav vezikne midyan ukesamim beyadam. (uvilam ovadoy benachash) ta chaze, bemilla defuma hava bilam rav mikkol charshin dealma, uveistakkeluta dehahu nachash, hava yada lechavvevna shaata. veal da baa balak leashlema milla (sefer acher kolla) kesem venachash.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, rasha, ha kedamucha banay. ovada it begavavyyhu, dechol sitrin bishin vezinin bishin vecharshin dealma la yachlin lekarva bahadayyhu, dechullehu arkin mikkammeh. umay ihu. ohel moed, umane kudesha, veshimmushe makdesha, uketoret busemin, deka mevattel kol ritcha verugeza dealma, dilella vetatta, veillavavn vekarbenin bechol yoma, utere mizbechot, lemebad ovada mizbechot, veshulchan velechem happanim, veet hakkiyyor veet kanno, vechamma shimmushin leovada, lemilla defuma, haaron utere luchayyay deorayyta, veaharon lechappera al amma bitzlota bechol yoma. kevan deashgach hahu rasha behay, amar ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael. may tama. Adonai elohav immo uteruat melech bo. veal da ammi zechar na, bevau minnayychu, havo dechirin hahu zimna deitchabbaru balak uvilam leshetzaa lechu, vela yachilu, daana achidna bechu, keabba deachid bivreh, vela shavik leh bida deochora. min hashshittim vead haggilgal, may da lokovel da. ella amar kudesha berich hu leyisrael, bevau minnayychu, havo dechirin kol zimna dahavittun achidan bi, vela yachil hahu rasha becharshoy vekismoy leshalletaa alayychu. kevan dishvaktun yedayychu leachada bi, vahavitun beshittim, ma ketiv. (Bamidbar 25:2) vayyochal haam vayishtachavu lelohehen. baggilgal, kema deat amer (Hoshea 12:12) baggilgal shevarim zibbechu, ucheden shelitu bechu sanechon.

Vechol da amay. lemaan daat tzidkot Adonai kol innun tzedakot, deavedna lechu, bezimna deattun achidan bi, vela shavikna milla dealma leshalletaa bechu, verugeza dilella vetatta, vezinin bishin, la yachlin lekarva bechu.

Vayyomer alehem linu fo hallayla vahashivoti etchem davar kaasher yedabber Adonai elay. ta chaze, beshaata deal shimsha, vetarin kullehu astimu, veal lelya veitchashach, kama chavile sharan meshshalshelehon, veazlin veshatan bealma, vechamma ravreve memanan alayyhu dimdabbere lehu. veit memana ravreva al kolla missitra dismala vehahu rasha hava shechiach legabbe hahu memana illaa mikkolla becharshoy. vehu hava amar becharshoy belelya, bezimna deihu shalta bechol siata dileh, vehu hava ate leishtakkecha gabbeh, veoda leh ma deihu bae.
1258: Da (Bereshit 31:24) vayyavo elohim el lavan haarami, hahu dishchiach gabbeh. (Bereshit 20:3) vayyavo elohim el avimelech, kullehu kegavvna da. bechol atar ikrun leh beinnun charshin, veal da hava shechiach belelya yattir mibbimama. veha okmuha. vechol hane charshin vechakkimin havo laavimelech, dichtiv, (Bereshit 26:8) vayyashkef avimelech melech pelishtim bead hachallon. ketiv hacha bead hachallon, uchetiv hatam (Shoftim Adonai:28) bead hachallon nishkefa vatteyabbev em sisra. lavan ha ukemuha, bilam keden.

Veal da bechullehu ketiv elohim, vayyavo elohim el bilam, vayyavo elohim el lavan, vayyavo elohim el avimelech, hu ata legabbayyhu, velav innun legabbeh, deha let lehu atar zammin. vei tema, ha ketiv elohim. ella, shema da ishtetaf becholla, vaafillu avoda zara name elohim ikre, elohim acherim, uvichlala deelohim acherim illen memanan, uvichlala da havo, uvegin kach ikre hache. vehahu rasha hava amar becharshoy vekare leh, veate legabbeh. uvegin kach ketiv (Bamidbar 22:8) linu fo hallayla vahashivoti etchem davar kaasher yedabber Adonai elay. hahu rasha ka meshabbach garmeh, deha la ketiv beh, ella vayyavo elohim.

Davar acher kaasher yedabber Adonai elay, al yede dehahu shelicha desitra ochora. vei tema ha bimama ishtechach legabbeh. (sefer acher kad hava legabbeh balak ella) ella vadday benachash istakkeluta hava beh, uvehahu zimna hava mistakkel lechavvevna shaata, hada hu dichtiv velo halach kefaam befaam likrat nechashim. vayyar bilam ki tov beene Adonai levarech et yisrael. ella dehahu yoma istakkal lechavvevna shaata, vela ishtekach kishar yome, ucheden chama deha rugeza rabba la ishtekach bealma, keden yada ki tov beene Adonai levarech et yisrael. behahu zimna shavik garmeh mikkol nechashim dealma, vela istekal behu, hada hu dichtiv velo halach kefaam befaam likrat nechashim.

Ta chaze, behahi shaata derittecha ishtechach, keden semala ittear, vahava yada hahu rasha atar, leachada besitra semala, lemelat. veistakkal behahu zimna, vela ishtechach. keden ma ketiv, (Bamidbar 23:8) ma ekkov lo kabbo el uma ezom lo zaam Adonai. uvegin kach, (Micha 6:Adonai) ammi zechar na ma yaatz balak vegomer. ume ana oto bilam ben beor (begin kach) zakkain innun yisrael, zakkaa chulakehon bealma den uvealma deate. (demarehon ochach lon hachi)

(Vayikra 26:3) im bechukkotay telechu. im bechukkotay, da atar digzirin deorayyta talyayn behahu atar, kema deat amer (Vayikra 18:4) et chukkotay tishmoru. chok hu deikre hachi, ugezirin deorayyta bah itkelilan. (Vayikra 25:18) veet mishpatay tishmeru. mishpatay, da hu atar ochora illaa, dehahi chukka achidat beh, umitchabberan da beda deillae vetattae. vechol pikkude orayyta, vechol gizre orayyta, vechol kiddushe orayyta, behane achidan. begin dehay tora shebbichtav, vehay tora shebbeal pe.

Veal da im bechukkotay, kol innun gezirin vedinin veonashin ufikkudin, deinnun behahu atar deikre tora shebbeal pe, chukka. veet mishpatay tishmoru, behahu atar deikre tora shebbichtav, kema deat amer (Tehillim 81:5) mishpat lelohe yaakov. veda achid beda veda beda, vecholla chad. veda hu kelala dishma kaddisha uman deabar al pitgame orayyta, keillu pagim shema kaddisha, begin dechok umishpat shema dekudesha berich hu havi. veal da, im bechukkotay telechu: da tora shebbeal pe. veet mishpatay tishmeru: da tora shebbichtav. veda hu kelala dishma kaddisha.

Vaasitem otam. may vaasitem otam, kevan deamar telechu vetishmeru, amay vaasitem. ella, man deavid pikkude orayyta veazil beorchoy, kivyachol keillu avid leh leella. amar kudesha berich hu, keillu asaani, veokmuha. veal da vaasitem otam. vaasitem attem ketiv vadday, vehoil umitare alayychu leitchabbera da beda, leishtakkecha shema kaddisha kedka yeot, vaasitem attem vadday.

Kegavvna da amar ribbi shimon, (Shmuel 2 8:13) vayyaas david shem, vechi david avad leh. ella begin deazil bearche deorayyta, veavid pikkude orayyta, veanhig malchuta kedka yeot, kivyachol, asa shem leella. vela hava malka bealma dezacha
1259: Lehay kedavid, dehava kam befalgut lelya, vahava meshabbach leh lekudesha berich hu, ad desalik shema kaddisha bechuresyyay, beshaata desalik nehora dimama. kivyachol hu avad shem mammash kema deat amer, (Vayikra 24:11) vayyikkov ben haishsha hayyisreelit et hashshem vaykallel. uvegin kach vayyaas david shem. veal da vaasitem otam ketiv, vei attun tishtaddelun lemebad lon, leittakna shema kaddisha kedka yaut, kol innun birchan dilella yishtakkechun gabbayychu betikkunehon kedka yeot.

(Vayikra 26:4) venatatti gishmechem beittam vegomer. kol chad vechad, yitten chela dileh alayychu. man innun. hahu tikkuna daavadtun dehahu shema kaddisha kegavvna da ketiv, (Bereshit 18:19) veshamru derech Adonai laasot tzedaka umishpat. vechi kevan dichtiv veshamru derech Adonai, amay laasot tzedaka umishpat. ella man denatir orchoy deorayyta, kivyachol hu ose tzedaka umishpat. umay tzedaka umishpat. da kudesha berich hu. bacha rabbi shimon veamar, vavy lon livne nasha, dela yadin vela mashgichin bikara demarehon, man avid shema kaddisha bechol yoma, havi ema man deyahiv tzedaka lemiskene.

Ta chaze, ha ukemuha hachi hu, demiskena achid beh bedina, vechol mechlayyhu bedina hu, atar deikre tzedek, kema deat amer (tehillim 22) tefilla leani chi yaatof. tefilla, da tefilla shel yad, veokimna. uman deyahiv leh tzedaka lemiskena, hu avid leella shema kaddisha shelim kedka yaut. begin ditzdaka da ilana dechayye, utzedaka yahiv letzedek. vechad yahiv letzedek, keden itchabbar da beda, ushema kaddisha ishtechach shelim. man avid da ittearuta (davar acher deavid itaruta da) diltatta, vadday keillu avid shema kaddisha bishlimu. kegavvna deihu avid letatta, hachi ittear leella. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 106:3) ashre shomre mishpat ose tzedaka bechol et. ose tzedaka, da kudesha berich hu, kivyachol hu avid leh.
Ta chaze, miskena ha ittemar man hu atreh. may tama. begin demiskena la it leh midileh kelum, ella ma deyahavin leh vesihara la it lah nehora midilah, ella ma deyahiv lah shimsha.

Ta chaze, amay ani chashuv kammet, may tama. begin dehahu atar garim leh, deha baatar demota hu shechiach, uvegin kach ikre met. hahu dechayis aleh, hu yahiv leh tzedaka, ilana dechayye sharya aloy. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 10:2) utzedaka tatztzil mimmavt. uchegavvna deavid bar nash letatta, hachi name avid leella mammash. zakkaa chulakeh dezache lemebad shema kaddisha leella, begin kach tzedaka salik al kolla.

Vehane mile, tzedaka lishmah. deha ittear tzedaka letzedek, lechabbera lon kachada, ulemehevi kolla shema kaddisha kedka yaut. deha tzedek, la ittakkan, vela ishtelim, ella bitzdaka. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:14) bitzdaka tikkonani, velichneset yisrael ittemar, uvegin kach vaasitem otam vegomer.

(Vayikra 26:6) venatatti shalom baaretz ushechavtem veen macharid vegomer. ribbi yose patach, (Tehillim 4:Adonai) rigzu veal techetau vegomer. rigzu veal techotau, hay kera ukemuha, devae bar nash leargaza yetzer tov al yetzer hara, veshappir. aval beshaata deramash lelya, uvar nash shachiv al arseh, kama gardine nimusin mitarin bealma, veazlin veshatin, uvene nasha baan leitraggeza mikkame kudesha berich hu, uledachala minneh, begin dela yishtekach nafsheh begavvayyhu, veyishteziv minnayyhu. veyive leh lebar nash, dela yappik minnayyhu milla befumeh. begin dela yittear lehu legabbeh, vela yishtakkechun bahaddeh. hada hu dichtiv imru vilvavchem al mishkavchem vedommu sela. dela yappik minnayyhu milla mippumeh.

Ta chaze, beshaata deishtechachu yisrael zakkain kamme kudesha berich hu, ma ketiv, venatatti shalom baaretz. hay leella. deate kudesha berich hu leitchabbera bichneset yisrael. keden ushechavtem veen macharid. may tama. begin vehishbatti chayya raa min haaretz.
1260: Da chayya dezina bisha letatta. umay ihi. agrat bat machalat, hi, vechol siata dilah. hay belelya. bimama, bene nasha deatu missitraha da, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 26:6) vecherev lo taavor beartzechem.

Ribbi abba amar, ha ukemuha deafillu cherev shel shalom, kegon paro necho. aval vecherev lo taavor, da siata dilah. vehishbatti chayya raa, dela tishlot beara, vaafillu haavara bealma lo taavor alayychu, vaafillu cherev dishar ammin, vaafillu bar nash mizyayna, la yaavor alayychu.

Veda darish yoshiyyahu malka, veokmuha dehu atpas bechovayyhu deyisrael. kema dichtiv, (Eicha 4:20) ruach appenu meshiach Adonai nilkad bishchitotam vegomer. hacha it leistakkela, deha tanenan i resha deamma hu tav, kol amma mishtezvan begineh. vei resha deamma la itkeshar, kol amma ittafsan bechoveh. veha yoshiyyahu resha dechashra hava, veovadoy mitkashsheran. amay itpas bechovehon deyisrael.

Ella al dela hayyemin beh beyirmiyahu, vela kafit lehu leyisrael, dechashiv dechullehu zakkain kevavteh. vahava amar leh yirmiyya, vela hayyemin beh. uvegin kach itpas bechovehon. veod desihara hava maich nehora, uvaya leastema.

(Vayikra 26:11) venatatti mishkani betochchem vegomer. venatatti mishkani, da shechinta. mishkani: mashkona dili. dehi itmashkena bechovayyhu deyisrael. venatatti mishkani, mashkoni vadday. metal lebar nash dehava rechima leochora, amar leh vday birchimuta illaa deit li gabbach, baena ledayyeyra immach. amar hech enda detedur gabbay, natal kol kissufa deveteh, veayyte legabbeh, amar ha mashkona legabbach, dela itperash minach lealmin.

Kach kudesha berich hu, baa ledayyeyra behu beyisrael, ma avad, natal kissufa dileh, venachit lehu leyisrael. amar lon, yisrael, ha mashkona dili gabbayychu, begin dela itperash minnayychu lealmin. veaf al gav dekudesha berich hu itrechik minan, mashkona shavik bidan, vaanan natrin hahu kissufa dileh, man deyive mashkoneh yete ledayyeyra gabban begin kach venatatti mishkani betochchem, mashkona etten bidayychu, begin deeddur immechon. veaf al gav deyisrael hasheta begaluta, mashkona dekudesha berich hu, hu gabbayyhu, vela shavku leh lealmin.

Velo tigal nafshi etchem, lebar nash derachim lechavreh, uvaa ledayyeyra immeh, ma avad, natal arsa dileh veayyti leveteh. amar da arsa dili bevetaych, begin dela archik minach, arsach, umanach. kach kudesha berich hu amar, venatatti mishkani betochchem velo tigal nafshi etchem, ha arsa dili bevetayychu, kevan dearsa dili immechon, tindeun dela itperash minnayychu, uvegin kach velo tigal nafshi etchem.

(Vayikra 26:12) vehithallachti betochchem vehayiti lachem lelohim, kevan demashkena dili gabbayychu, bevadday tindeun daana azil immechon, kema deat amer (Devarim 23:15) ki Adonai elohecha mithallech bekerev machanecha lehatztzilcha velatet oyvecha lefanecha vehaya machanecha kadosh.

Ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda, havo shechiche lelya chad bichfar kariv leyamma ditverya, kamu befalgut lelya amar ribbi yitzchak leribbi yehuda nema bemille deorayyta deaf al gav daanan baatar da, la baena leitparsha meilana dechayye.

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar, (Shemot 33:7) umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane vegomer. umoshe yikkach et haohel, amay. ella amar moshe, hoil veyisrael ka meshakkere beh bekudesha berich hu, veachlifu yekara dileh, ha mashkona dileh yehe bida dimhemana, ad denecheme beman yishtear.
Amar leh liyhoshua, ant tehe mehemna ben kudesha berich hu, uven yisrael, veyishtear mashkona bidach behemnuta, venechome
1261: Beman yishtear. ma ketiv, veshav el hammachane umesharato yehoshua bin nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel. may taama liyhoshua begin deihu kesihara legabbe shimsha, veihu itchaze lenatra mashkona. veal da, lo yamish mittoch haohel.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu lemoshe, moshe, la itchaze hachi, deha mashkona dili yahavit bidayyhu, af al gav deinnun chavu legabbay, mashkona yehe legabbayyhu, dela yitparshun minneh. (sefer acher dela itperash minnayyhu) tive deitperash minnayyhu deyisrael, vela etuv legabbayyhu lealmin, ella ativ mashkona dili legabbayyhu, uvegineh la eshbok lehon bechol atar.

Af al gav deyisrael chavu legabbeh dekudesha berich hu, hay mashkona dileh la shavku, vekudesha berich hu la natil leh mibbenayyhu. veal da, bechol atar degalle yisrael, shechina immehon. veal da ketiv, venatatti mishkani betochchem. veha ukemuha.

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar (Shir HaShirim 2:9) dome dodi litzvi o leofer haayyalim hinne ze vegomer. zakkain innun yisrael, dezachu demashkona da lemehevi gabbayyhu, min malka illaa. deaf al gav deinnun begaluta, kudesha berich hu ate bechol resh yarche veshabbatte uzemane, leashgecha alayyhu, uleistakkela behahu mashkona deit leh gabbayyhu, deihu kissufa dileh.
