Lemalka desarcha matronita, afkah mehechaleh. ma avdat. natlat berah dileh kissufa demalka, rechima dileh. uvegin dedata demalka alah, shavkeh bidaha. beshaata desalik reuta demalka, al matronita, veal bere, hava salik agrin, venachit dargin, vesalik kotalin, leistakkela uleashgacha ben nukeve kotala alayyhu, kevan dechame lon, share bache meachore kusete kotala, ulevatar azil leh.

Kach yisrael, af al gav deinnun nafku mehechaleh demalka, hahu mashkona la shavku, uvegin diruta demalka alayyhu, shavkeh immehon. beshaata desalik reuta demalka kaddisha, al matronita veal yisrael. salik agrin (mekappetz al haggevaot), nachit dargin, vesalik kotalin, leistakkela uleashgacha ben kusete kotala alayyhu. kevan dechame lon, share uvache, hada hu dichtiv dome dodi litzvi o leofer haayyalim ledallega mikkotala leigra, umeigra lechotala. hinne ze omed achar katlenu, bevatte kenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot mashgiach min hachallonot, (devadday bi kenishta bayay challonot). metzitz min hacharakkim, leistakkela uleashgacha alayyhu. uvegin kach, yisrael bau lemechde behahu yoma, deinhu yade da, veamre. (Tehillim 118:24) ze hayyom asa Adonai nagila venismecha bo.

(Vayikra 26:15) veim bechukkotay timasu vegomer. ribbi yose patach, (Mishlei 3:11) musar Adonai beni al timas veal takotz betochachto. kama chavivin yisrael kamme kudesha berich hu, dekudesha berich hu bae leochacha lehu, uledabbera lehu beorach meshar, keabba derachim livreh, umiggo rechimu dileh legabbeh, sharvita bideh tadir, ledabbera leh beorach meshar, dela yiste limina velismala. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:12) ki et asher yeehav Adonai yochiach ucheav et ben yirtze. uman dela rachim leh kudesha berich hu, vesane leh, salik minneh tochacha, salik minneh sharvita.

Ketiv. (Malachi 1:2) ahavti etchem amar Adonai vegomer, miggo rechimuta dileh, sharvita bideh tadir, ledabbera leh. veet esav saneti, begin kach selikit minneh sharvita, selikat minneh tochachta, begin dela etten leh bi chulaka, rechika denafshay hu. aval attun, ahavti etchem vadday. uvegin kach, musar Adonai beni al timas veal takotz betochachto. may veal takotz. la tekutzun beh, keman dearak miggo guvin, deinnun millin kegovin legabbeh begarmeh.

Ta chaze, beshaata deittear tzedek bedinoy. kama sitre tehirin, mitarin mimina umissemala, kama sharvitin nafkin, minnehon sharvite eshsha, sharvite gumerin, sharvite shalhova, kullehu nafkin umitarin bealma, velakan livne nasha. techotayyhu memanan ochoranin, mare tafsin, memanan dearbein chaser chad. shatin venachtin, lakan vesallekin, venatlin reshuta, ayylin
1262: Benukeba dithoma rabba, metzavin tafse, venora dedalik itchabbar behu, nafke gumerin veshatin venachtin, veishtechachu lokovlehon divne nasha. vehayeynu dichtiv, veyasafti leyassera etchem etten lemarehon dedina, tosefet al dina dilhon.

Kema deat amer, (Bereshit 8:21) lo osif lekallel od et haadama baavur haadam. may lo osif. lo etten tosefet lemare dina leshetzaa alma, ella tosefet kegavvna deyachil alma lemisbal. veal da veyasafti, etten tosefet vadday.

Tosefet amay. begin leyassera etchem sheva al chattotechem. sheva, veha kudesha berich hu i gave hahu dilay la yachil alma lemisbal afillu riga chada, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 130:3) im avonot tishmor yah Adonai mi yaamod, veat amart sheva al chattotechem.

Ella ma talmud lomar sheva. ella ha sheva lokovlayychu. umay ihi. da shemitta, deihi sheva, deikre sheva, kema deat amer, (Devarim 15:1) mikketz sheva shanim taase shemitta. veal da sheva al chattotechem, veikre sheva, veikre bat sheva. ma ben hay lehay. ella sheva bilchodaha, lemebad shemitta, ulemebad dinin, leappaka cheru decholla ba. bat sheva ikre, deitchabbar beachra kachada, leanhara, lemishlat bemalchuta, leodaa malchuta beara uvecholla, bat sheva ikre. ketiv, (Bereshit 26:33) al ken shem hair beer sheva ad hayyom hazze. beer sheva, beera deyitzchak hu, vecholla chad milla hu.

Ribbi abba amar, (Vayikra 26:28) veyissarti etchem af ani sheva al chattotechem. veyissarti etchem, al yeda dimmanan ochoranin, kema deukemuha. af ani, ha ana ittear lokovlayychu. ha sheva, leitteara alayychu.

Ta chaze, rechimuta illaa dekudesha berich hu beyisrael, lemalka dehava leh bar yechiday, vahava chate kamme malka, yoma chad sarach kamme malka, amar malka, kol hane yomin alkena lach, vela kabbilt. mikkan veelach chame may abid lach, i attarich lach min ara, veappik lach mimmalchuta, dilma yekumun alach dubbe chakla, o zeeve chakla, o listin, veyaavrun lach mealma. ma abid. ella ana veant nefuk meara.

Kach af ani, ana veant nifuk meara (af ana veant nehach begaluta vaneypevak kachada). kach amar kudesha berich hu, yisrael ma abid lechu, ha alkena lechu, vela arkitu udenayychu, ha ayytena alayychu mare terisin, mare tafsin, lealkaa lechon, vela shematun. i appik lechu meara lechodchon, dachilna alayychu mikkamma dubbin, mikkamma zeevin, dikumun alayychu, veyaavrun lechu mealma. aval ma abid lechun, ella ana veattun nefuk meara, unehach begaluta. hada hu dichtiv veyissarti etchem lemehach begaluta. vei temrun deeshbok lechon, af ani immechon. sheva al chattotechem, da sheva deyittarach immechon, vaamay. al chattotechem. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:1) uvefishechem shullecha immechem. amar kudesha berich hu, attun geramtun, daana veattun la nedur (sefer acher beara) bealma (nusach acher nateraved 3 mealma). ha matronita nafkat mehechala immechon, ha itcharev kolla, hechala dili vedilchon itcharav. deha lemalka la itchaze hechala, ella kad ihu ayel im matronita. vechedva demalka la ishtechach.

Ella beshaata deal behechala dematronita, veishtechach beraha immah behechala, chaddan kullehu kachada. hasheta dela ishtechachu bera umatronita, ha hechala chareva mikkolla. ella ana ma abid. af ana immechon. vehasheta af al gav deyisrael inhu begaluta, kudesha berich hu ishtechach immehon, vela shavik lon, dechad yifkun, yisrael min galuta, kudesha berich hu, yetuv immehon. dichtiv, (Devarim 30) veshav Adonai elohecha, veshav Adonai elohecha vadday. veha ittemar.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havo azle bearcha, arau behahi mearta bechakla. amar ribbi chiyyay leribbi yose, hay dichtiv, (Devarim 28:69) elle divre habberit vegomer, millevad habberit. may divre habberit. divre gevura (sefer acher haelle) mibbae leh. amar leh ha ukemuha, hallalu mippi haggevura, vehallalu mippi atzmo shel moshe, veha ittemar.
Ta chaze, illen veillen divre habberit havo,
1263: Deaf al gav demippi haggevura havo millin. mile berit havo, deha tav uvish beh talyayn. tav deate mitzaddik. bish deate min dina. dina, meatar dedina, vehayeynu tzedek. vetzaddik vetzedek berit innun, berit ikrun. veal da, millin illen, mile berit innun. vekashir berit kachada. uvegine kach zachor veshamor, kashir kachada. zachor beyom, shamor ballayla. ha berit kachada, uvegin kach berit vadday, divre habberit ninhu. uvechol atar berit baatar da ihu.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday hachi hu, uvegin kach shabbat deihu zachor veshamor, ikre berit. dichtiv, (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat laasot et hashshabbat ledorotam berit olam. vecholla milla chad, vaatar da, ikre berit bechol atar.

Ta chaze, ketiv venatatti shalom baaretz, hu yesod, deihu shelama deara, shelama deveta, shelama dealma. veyissarti etchem af ani sheva. may 7. da tzedek. ha vadday berit, uvegin kach divre habberit ninhu.

Amar ribbi yose ketiv. (Vayikra 26:44) veaf gam zot bihyotam beeretz oyvehem vegomer. veaf gam zot, veaf, kema deat amer, af ani. gam, lerabbot keneset yisrael, deikre zot, dela shavkat lon lealmin. bihyotam beeretz oyvehem, bihyotam kolla kachada. lo meastim velo gealtim begin dela itchabbar behu. lehafer beriti ittam, dei la efrok lehu, ha beriti palig, uvegin kach lehafer beriti ittam.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, ana shemana milla chadta, deamar ribbi elazar lo meastim velo gealtim lechallotam, la hikkitim vela haragtim lechallotam mibbae leh. ella la meastim vela gealtim, man desane leochora mais hu lokovleh, vegaala hu begiula kammeh. aval hacha, la meastim vela gealtim. may tama. begin dachavivuta denafshay benayyhu. uveginah kullehu chavivin gabbay, hada hu dichtiv lechallotam. lechallotam ketiv, chaser vav, beginah la meastim vela gealtim, begin deihi rechimata denafshay, rechimuta dili gabbaha.

Lebar nash derachim itteta, vahavavt dayyra beshuka devuresake, i la havavt hi tamman, la ayel bah lealmin. kevan dehi tamman, dame beenoy keshuka derochle, dechol rechin dealmin tavin ishtechachu tamman.

Uf hacha, veaf gam zot bihyotam beeretz oyvehem, deihu shuka devuresake, lo meastim velo gealtim. vaamay. lechallotam. begin kallatam, daana rechimna lah, deihi rechimata denafshay, desharya tamman, vedami alay kechol rechin tavan dealma, begin hahi kalla divgavavyyhu. amar ribbi yose, illu la atena hacha, ella lemishma milla da dayy.

Patach veamar, (Malachi 1:6) ben yechabbed av veeved adonav. ben yechabbed av, kema deat amer (Shemot 20:12) kabbed et avicha veet immecha, veokmuha, bemechla umishteyay uvecholla. hay bechayyyoy deitchayyayv beh. batar demit, i tema ha patur minneh hu, lav hache. deaf al gav demit, itchayyayv bikareh yattir, dichtiv kabbed et avicha. dei hahu bera azil beorach tekala, vadday mevazze laavuy hu, vadday avid leh kelana. vei hahu bera azil beorach meshar, vetakin ovadoy, vadday da okir laavuy, okir leh behay alma gabbe bene nasha, okir leh behahu alma, gabbe kudesha berich hu. vekudesha berich hu chayis aleh, veotiv leh bechuresyay dikareh. vadday ben yechabbed av.

Kegon ribbi elazar, deihu okir leh laavuy behay alma, uvehahu alma hasheta asge shevacha derabbi shimon bitren almin, behay alma, uvehahu alma yattir mechayyyoy. dezacha livnin kaddishin, ulegizin kaddishin. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dezakkan livnin kaddishin, legizin kaddishin. alayyhu itkere, (Yeshayahu 61:9) kol roehem yakkirum ki hem zera berach Adonai amen. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen.
1264: (Bamidbar 1:1) vaydabber Adonai el moshe bemidbar sinay beohel moed vegomer, ribbi abba patach, (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo vegomer, hay kera ittemar. ta chaze, beshaata devara kudesha berich hu leadam aved leh bediyyukena deillae vetattae, vahava kalil mikkolla, vahava nehoreh nahir, missayyfe alma ad sayyfe alma. vahavu dachalin kammeh kolla.

Veaf al gav deha ukemuha, it leistakkela beh behay kera, vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo betzelem elohim bara oto, kevan deamar betzalmo, may betzelem elohim bara oto. ella vadday teren dargin dichlilan dechar venukeba, chad lidchar, vechad lenukeba.

Uvegin kach du partzufin havo vday, vesefa dikra ochach, dichtiv zachar unekeva bara otam. vechalil hava mikkol sitrin (nusach acher muttarin sitrin) veaf al gav denukeba achidat besitroy. ha hi name kelila mitteren sitrin, lemehevi shelim becholla.

Vahava mistakkal bechachmeta, leella vetatta. kevan dessarach, itmaatu partzufin, vechachmmeta istalakat minneh, vela hava mistachal ella bemile degufeh. levatar olid benin meillae vetattae, vela ityashavu da veda bealma, ad deolid bar, uminneh ishtelim (sefer acher ashtil) alma, deikre shet, veha ukemuha.

Veim kol da, alma tattaa la ishtelim, vela hava shelim, vela ishtechach bekiyyumeh, ad deata avraham, veitkayyaym alma. aval la ishtelim, ad deavraham ishtechach beh bealma veachid beh bimina, keman deachid bimineh, leman denafil. ata yitzchak, veachid bideh dealma bismala, veitkayyaym yattir. kevan deata yaakov, achid beemtzaita begufa, veitkelil bitren sitrin, itkayyaym alma vela hava mitmotet.

Veim kol da la ashtil (sefer acher ishtelim) besharshoy, ad deolid teresar shevatin, veshivin nafshan, veashtil (sefer acher veishtelim) alma. veim kol da la ishtelim, ad dekabbilu yisrael orayyta betura desinay, veittekam mashkena. keden itkayyaymu almin veishtelimu, veitbesamu illain vetattain.
Kevan deorayyta umashkena ittokamu, baa kudesha berich hu lemifkad
1265: Cheloy deorayyta, kama chayyaylin innun deorayyta, kama chayyaylin innun demashkena. ta chaze, kol milla devae leityayshsheva beducheteh, la mityayshsheva ad deidkar befuma, veitmene alah. uf hacha, baa kudesha berich hu lemifkad chayyaylin deorayyta, vechayyaylin demashkena, vechullehu havo kechad vela mitparshe da min da, kolla kegavvna dilella, deha orayyta umashkena la mitparshe da min da, veazlin kachada.

Uvegin kach, chayyaylehon alin bechushebana leishtemoda gabbayyhu, bar innun acharanin delet lon chushebana. uvegin kach ketiv, vaydabber Adonai el moshe bemidbar sinay beohel moed. i beohel moed, amay bemidbar sinay. ella chad leorayyta vechad lemashkena.

Vehay vehay, beechad lachodesh hashsheni bashshana hashshenit, vecholla chad, vehay ikre (Melachim 1 6:1) chodesh ziv remez lehahu yarcha veshatta denahir lesihara, deha keden almin kullehu ishtechachu bishlimu. letzetam meeretz mitzrayim, leishtemoda deha kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, bachodesh harishon hava.

Ribbi yitzchak patach, (Tehillim 115:12) Adonai zecharanu yevarech yevarech et bet vegomer. Adonai zecharanu yevarech, illen guverin. dahavo alin bechushebana bemadbera, vekudesha berich hu mevarech lon, veosif alayyhu bechol zimna.

Ta chaze, hay man deamar shevacha dechavreh, divnoy, o demamoneh, bae levarcha leh, uleodaa aleh birchan. menalan. mimmoshe. dichtiv, (Devarim 1:10) vehinnechem hayyom kechochve hashshamayim larov, levatar ma ketiv, Adonai elohe avotechem yosef alechem kachem elef peamim vegomer. teren birchan havo, chad Adonai elohe avotechem vegomer. ha chad. levatar vivarech etchem kaasher dibber lachem. leodaa alayyhu, birchan al birchan.

Vei ihu mane shevacha dechavreh, vela ode aleh birchan. hu nitpas bekadmita milleella. vei ihu mevarech leh, hu mitbarech milleella. uvircheta bae levarcha lah beena tava, vela beena bisha. uvecholla bae kudesha berich hu rechimuta delibba. uma man dimvarech lechavreh, bae kudesha berich hu diyyevarech leh beena tava, belibba tava. man dimvarech lekudesha berich hu, al achat kamma vechamma, devae ena tava, velibba tava, urechimuta delibba. begin kach (Devarim 6:Adonai) veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha vegomer.

Ta chaze, ha ukemuha let birchata dilella sharya, al milla deitmene. vei tema, yisrael ech itmenun. ella kufera natle minnayyhu, veha ukemuha, vechushebana la havi ad deyitkenish kol hahu kufera, vesalik lechushebna, uvekadmeta mevarchan lehu leyisrael, ulevatar menaan hahu kufera, ulevatar mehadderin umevarchin lon leyisrael. ishtechachu deyisrael mitbarchin bekadmita uvesofa, vela salik behu motana.

Motana amay salik beminyayna. ella begin devircheta la sharya beminyayna, kevan deistalak birchata, sitra achara share aloy, veyachil leatzeka. begin da beminyayna natlin kufera ufidyona, lesalleka aleh minnayyhu.

(Sefer acher mealeha motana) yevarech et bet yisrael, illen nashin, dela sallekin beminyayna. yevarech et bet aharon, deinnun mevarchin leamma, beena tava uvelibba tava, uvirchimuta delibba. et bet aharon, hachi name nashin (dilhon), deitbarchan bevirchata (sefer acher dilhon).
Yevarech yire Adonai. illen innun levae, vechullehu mitbarchin, begin dedachalin leh lekudesha berich hu. hakketanim im haggedolim, af al gav dela alin beminyayna.

Ta chaze la ishtechach minyayna behu beyisrael deitbarchan beh, kehay minyayna. dehay minyayna leitbarcha hava, uleashlema shelemuta dealmin hava, uvaatar devirkan nafkin itmenun, dichtiv beechad lachodesh hashsheni, deihu ziva devirkaan dealma, deminneh nafik ziva lealma. veal da ikre chodesh ziv, deziva decholla nafik minneh, veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 134:3) yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon, vecholla chad milla uchetiv (Tehillim 133:3) ki sham tzivva Adonai
1266: Ribbi yehuda hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon, amar leh yisrael mean atar itbarchan. amar leh, vavy lealma, dela mashgichin vela mistakkelin bene nasha, bikara demalka illaa. ta chaze, beshaata deishtechachu yisrael zakkain kamme kudesha berich hu, vahavu almin (sefer acher immeh) shechichin bechad ilana illaa kaddisha, dimzona decholla beh, hava mitbarech meatar dechol birchan kenishin beh. uveh itneta veashtilu sharshoy.

Veyisrael letatta, havo mitbarchan (veashtilu sharshoy) meatar dechol innun birchan nafkin beh, vela mitakkeve lemeppak, hada hu dichtiv yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon, uchetiv (Tehillim 133:3) ketal chermon sheyyored al harere tziyyon ki sham tzivva Adonai et habberacha chayyim ad haolam. veda ihu nehiru dealma. dichtiv, (Tehillim 50:2) mitztziyyon mikkelal yofi elohim hofia. hofia: nahir. kema deat amer (Devarim 33:2) hofia mehar paran (sefer acher veda nehiru). vechad yenaher, yenaher lechullehu almin.

Vechad hay nehiru ittear, kolla hu bechavruta (sefer acher kolla hu bachavivuta), kolla hu birchimuta, kolla hu bishlimu, keden hu shelama decholla, shelama deella vetatta, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:7) yehi shalom bechelech shalva bearmenotayich.

(Bamidbar 2:2) ish al diglo veotot levet avotam yachanu bene yisrael vegomer. ribbi elazar patach, (Yeshayahu 66:10) simchu et yerushala 40 vegilu bah kol ohaveha vegomer. kama chaviva orayyta kamme kudesha berich hu, deha bechol atar demille deorayyta ishtemau, kudesha berich hu vechol chayyaylin dileh kullehu tzayytin lemiluleh. vekudesha berich hu ate ledayyeyra immeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 20:21) bechol hamakom asher azkir et shemi vegomer. velo od, ella desanoy naflin kammeh, veha okmuha.

Ta chaze, pikkude orayyta illain innun leella. ate bar nash veavid pikkuda chada, hahu pikkuda kayyeyma kamme kudesha berich hu, umitattera kammeh, veamar pelanyay avad li, umin pelanyay ana, begin deihu ittear leh leella. kegavvna deihu ittear leh letatta, hachi name ittear leella, veavid shelama leella vetatta, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 27:5) o yachazek bemauzzi yaase shalom li shalom yaase li. yaase shalom li, leella. (leel 14 amud bet) shalom yaase li, letatta. zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, deavid pikkude orayyta.

Simchu et yerushalam vegomer, begin dechedva la ishtechach, ella bezimna deyisrael kayyme beara kaddisha. detamman itchabberat itteta bevalah, ucheden hu chedvavta decholla, chedvavta deella vetatta. bezimna deyisrael la ishtechachu beara kaddisha, asir leh lebar nash lemechode, uleachzaa chedu. dichtiv, simchu et yerushalam vegilu vah vegomer, vegilu vah dayyka.

Ribbi abba chama chad bar nash, dehava chadde beve teronyay devavel, batash beh, amar simchu et yerushalam ketiv (amar rabbi abba), bezimna diyrushala 40 bechedva, bae bar nash lemechde. ribbi elazar letameh, deamar simchu et yerushalam, hayeynu dichtiv, (Tehillim 100:2) ivdu et Adonai besimcha.

Katuv echad omer, ivdu et Adonai besimcha, vechatuv echad omer, (Tehillim 2:11) ivdu et Adonai beyira vegilu birada. ma ben hay lehay. ella, kan bezimna deyisrael sharan beara kaddisha. kan bezimna deyisrael sharan beara achara. (davar acher) ivdu et Adonai beyira, da keneset yisrael, bezimna deihi begaluta bene amamya.

Amar ribbi yehuda, veha ketiv (Yeshayahu 55:12) ki besimcha tetzeu, veda hi keneset yisrael, kevan deamar tetzeu, min galuta hu, veikre simcha. amar leh, vadday hachi hu, dechol zimna deihi begaluta ushechivat leafra, la ikre simcha, ad dekudesha berich hu yete legabbah, veyokim lah meafra, veyema (Yeshayahu 52:2) hitnaari meafar vegomer. (Yeshayahu 60:1) kumi ori vegomer. veyitchabberun kachada, (veyokim la meafra) keden chedvavta ikre. chedvavta decholla, ucheden besimcha tetzeu vadday. keden kama chayyaylin yippekun lokovla dematronita, lechedvavta dehillula demalka, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 55:12) heharim vehaggevaot yiftzechu vegomer, uchetiv (Yeshayahu 52:12) ki holech lifnechem Adonai umeassifchem vegomer.
1267: (Bamidbar 2:2) ish al diglo veotot. illen arba mashshiryayn dichneset yisrael, deinnun teresar shevatin, teresar techumin, sechor sechor lah. kolla kegavvna dilella, ketiv (Tehillim 122:4) sheshsham alu shevatim shivte yah vegomer. sheshsham alu shevatim, illen 12 shevatin, 12 techumin diltatta.

Shivte yah, ha ukemuha begin deyah edut leyisrael vadday. uvegin da, harouveni, hashshimoni, yah bechol chad vechad. aval vadday hachi hu, deha ilana illaa kaddisha, behu achtam bechotamoy. veokmuha dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:10) udemut penehem pene adam ufene arye el hayyamin vegomer. diyyukena deadam itkelil bechullehu, veappin havo led sitrin dealma, umitparshan bediyyukenehon, vechulhon kelilan beh beadam.

Michael mimina, gavriel missemala, uriel lekadmayyhu, refael laachorayyhu, shechinta alayyhu. teren mikkan, uteren mikkan, vehi beemtzaita. kegavvna da beara diltatta, tere mikkan, utere mikkan, veyah benayyhu.

Kevan denatlin teren degalim, ma ketiv. venasa ohel moed machane haleviyyim vegomer. ulevatar, innun teren acharanin 4 mashshiryayn innun led sitre alma, veishtechachu teresar. uf hachi letatta kegavvna dilella.

Venasa barishona degel machane yehuda, lokovel mashshiryay deuriel. umachane diruven lokovel mashshiryay demichael. da laddarom, veda lemizrach. mizbeach hachi name deromit mizrachit. umachane dan latztzafon. machane efrayim yama. machane dan lokovel mashshiryay degavriel. machane efrayim lemaarav, lokovel mashshiryay dirfael mizbeach hachi name tzefonit maaravit. kolla achid da beda, ad desalleka kolla veitachad bishma kaddisha, deihu sheruta decholla. illaa decholla kaddisha decholla. kolla itkelil beh.
10 Mizrach hu sheruta dinhora, azil veshat veappik ledarom. vedarom nafik vetalyay besheruta demizrach. Adonai darom. minneh nafik darom bealma. veayil 10 besheruta demizrach, veappik leh.

Umin Adonai talyay darom vetzafon, vehahu (8) devenayyhu, 10 mizrach yah darom vetzafon talyayn beh. 6 beemtzaita. veda hu ben dechar. begin kach ihu ben tzafon ledarom. veal da tanenan, man deyahiv mittato ben tzafon ledarom, haveyayn leh banim zecharim. dehay ben dechar ihu ben tzafon ledarom. Adonai illaa bah talya tzafon vedarom, uven dechar benayyhu, beraza deyv. Adonai batraa maarav.
Veal da darom achid mizrach, deihu sheruta deshimsha vetalyay beh. veal da tanenan, missitra deabba achid vetalyay chesed illaa. missitra deima talyay gevura. kegavvna da achid kolla da beda.

Zavvyayn demadbecha hachi name istacharan, uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit. dedarom tukepeh bemizrach, deihu sheruta deshimsha, vetukepa deshimsha la sharyay ella besheruta. mizrachit tzefonit. kevan dedarom natil tukepeh demizrach, hu anhir latztzafon vetzafon itkelil bedarom, deha semala itkelil bimina.

Tzefonit maaravit, deha maarav deihi baAdonai batraa, natla mitztzafon. veal da tzafon azil lemaarav. maaravit deromit, hi azla (sefer acher laatachebakea) leitchabbera bedarom, kema dedarom talyay bemizrach, vetukepeh azil besheruta. hachi name maarav, azla (sefer acher laatachebakea) leitachada bedarom, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) vimino techabbekeni. yemina da hu darom. begin kach yanka mitteren sitrin, mitztzafon umiddarom. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. semolo da hu tzafon, vimino da hu darom.

Veraza da olifna, kudesha berich hu yahiv mittateh, ben tzafon ledarom. vaachidat lehay ben vday. veal da it lehu livne nasha lemehav mittatayyhu ben tzafon ledarom. vehachi olif li abba. deyahavin lehu benin dichrin. deha ihu itkevavn kelappe mehemnuta shelema illaa, bishlemuta decholla. legabbe kudesha berich hu deihu ben tzafon ledarom, ulegabbe keneset yisrael deanhirin (sefer acher deihi) ben tzafon ledarom. vadday yehevvan leh benin dichrin.
1268: Bae leachazaa ovada kegavvna dilella, uchemma deachze ovada letatta, hachi name ittear leella, veokmuha. shama ribbi pinchas, uneshakeh leribbi elazar, uvacha vechayich amar, zakkaa chulaki behay alma uvealma deate.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 27:1) Adonai ori veyishi mimmi ira vegomer. Adonai ori veyishi, kevan devar nash istakkal (nusach acher itachad) binhora dilella, vekudesha berich hu anhir aleh, la dachil meilain vetattain. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 60:2) vealayich yizrach Adonai uchevodo alayich yerae. Adonai maoz chayay, kevan dekudesha berich hu achid beh bevar nash, la mistafe behahu alma mikkol marehon dedinin. uf ana kehay gavvna, kevan deachidna beavuch uvach la estafena behay alma uvealma achara.

Vealach ketiv, (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha vegomer. kevan dichtiv yismach avicha veimmecha, may vetagel yoladtecha, deha beimmecha sagya. ella yismach avicha: da kudesha berich hu. veimmecha: da keneset yisrael. vetagel yoladtecha: yoladtecha diltatta. ribbi shimon avuch an chedvavta dileh. ella kera hu bilchodoy dichtiv, (Mishlei 23:24) gil yagil avi tzaddik: da kudesha berich hu. veyoled chacham yismach bo: da avicha diltatta. davar acher, gil yagil avi tzaddik: da avicha diltatta. veyoled chacham yismach bo, ketiv betosefet vav, da kudesha berich hu hu leella.

Amar ribbi elazar, ketiv (Tehillim 31:6) beyadcha afkid ruchi padita oti Adonai el emet. hay kera it leh leistakkela beh, chamittun man deafkid bida demalka midi. ella, vadday zakkaa hu bar nash, deazil beorchoy demalka kaddisha, vela chate kammeh ta chaze, kevan deal lelya, ilana demota shallit bealma, veilana dechayye istallak leella leella. vechevan deilana demota shallit bealma bilchodoy, kol bene alma taamin taama demota. may tama. begin dehahu ilana garim.

Uvar nash bae leakdema ulemifkad bideh nafsheh befikdona. kefikdona devar nash, deyahiv pikdona leachara, deaf al gav deihu itchayyayv legabbeh yattir mehahu pikdona, lav keday leitachada beh, hoil ufikdona itmesar legabbeh, vei yesarev beh, vadday nivduk avatreh, delav mizzara kaddisha hu, velav mibbene mehemnuta.

Kach hahu ilana, bene nasha akdimu veyahavin leh pikdona denafshayyhu, vechol nishmatin divne alma natil. vechullehu taamin taama demota, begin dehay ilana demota hu. uvegin dechol innun nafshata, af al gav dechullehu itchayyvu legabbeh, velav keday hu leatava pikdona legabbeh devar nash, ella kevan dechullehu itmesari leh befikdona, ativ kol pikdonin lemarehon.

Ta chaze, lav keday hu hay ilana demota leatava pikdona legabbeh devar nash. ella beshaata deilana dechayye ittear bealma. veematay ittear hahu ilana dechayye. beshaata desalik tzafra. ucheden, kevan dehay ittear bealma, kol bene alma chayyin, veshavik veahdar hahu ilana demota kol pikdonin deitpekadu legabbeh, veazil leh. may tama chayyin. begin dehahu ilana dechayye garim.

Vei tema, ha bene nasha saggiin innun demitarin belelya, beod deilana demota shallit. ella, vadday hahu ilana dechayye ka avid. may tama. begin dichtiv, (Tehillim 14:2) lirot hayesh maskil doresh et elohim. vela yehe leh pitchon pe levar nash, deyemma, ilmale shelitna benafshay belelya ishtaddalna beorayyta. amar ribbi yehuda, hay beyisrael vadday vehachi hu. aval beumot haolam dachamena kehay gavvna, may tama. amar leh vadday shappir hu deka amart.

Patach veamar, (Bamidbar 23:8) ma ekkov lo kabbo el uma ezom lo zaam Adonai. ta chaze, kegavvna deit leella, it letatta. leella it yemina veit semala. letatta yisrael veammin. yisrael itachadan limina, bikdushsha demalka kaddisha. ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot lismala, lesitra deruach misava. vechullehu letatta mikkullehu dargin dismala. vechullehu dargin achidan da beda,
1269: Ad detalyayn min resha. uchegavvna deresha natil, behahu gavvna natil zanva, deihi tattaa. may tama. begin deachid beh. uvegin kach, ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, behahu setar misava dilhon, hachi itdebaru.

Bilam hu ishtammash bechullehu kitrin (nusach acher dargin) tattain. vehu hava chame behay tattaa deihu zanva, dela yachil leitdabbera ella beresha. begin kach amar, ma ekkov lo kabbo el, (deihu resha begin) dehahu resha illaa, la ishtechach bedina beinnun yomin.

Veaf al gav dehay el okimna, hay malchuta kaddisha natil shema kegavvna decholla, vehay tav vechesed dehay alma (sefer acher okimna baatar achara illaa vehu tav vechesed alma hay malchuta kaddisha natil shemma kegavvna deella) uvegin kach ikre el, ella deihu (leel 32) zoem bechol yom, deishtechach beh dina.

Veta chaze, el shadday (Shemot 253 amud alef) ha okimna deveh sippuka dealma veihu amar laolam day, deha hay el hu deizdevvavg bahadeh, uvegin kach ikre el shadday, el deshadday. veal da ma ekkov lo kabbo el. begin kach, kegavvna deittear resha, hachi name ittear tattaa.

Bacha ribbi elazar, patach veamar (Yirmeyahu 46:22) kolah kannachash yelech vegomer. hasheta (kehay gavvna) deyisrael begaluta, ihi vadday azla kenachash. chivya kad ihu (davar acher bedina) kafif resha leafra, salik zanva, shallit umache lechol innun deishtechachu kammeh. uf hachi hasheta begaluta, kehay gavvna, resha kafif leafra, vezanva shallit. man avid lezanva deyistelik leella veshalit umache, resha deitkafya letatta. veim kol da, man madbar leh lezanva, uman natil leh lematalnoy. hay resha. af al gav deihu kafif leafra, hu madbar lematalnoy, begin da kolah kannachash yelech.

Vehasheta shear ammin deinnun achidan biznava, sallekin leella, veshaltin umachyayn, veresha kafif leafra, kema deat amer (Amos Adonai:2) nafla lo tosif kum vegomer. veim kol da, hay resha madbar lezanva venatir (sefer acher venatil) leh, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 1:6) samuni notera et hakkeramim, illen ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, deinnun zanva. ata ribbi yehuda venashik yedoy, amar ilmale la shailna milla bealma, ella deshailna da veravavchna leh, day li. dehashta yedana ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, veshuletanuta dilhon hech mitdabbar. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dealayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 135:4) ki yaakov bachar lo yah vegomer.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, mahu lisgullato. amar leh, telat avahan illen ikrun segula, ben leella ben letatta, kegavvna da kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim, vecholla chad. veillen segullato shel kudesha berich hu leella, usegullato letatta, veda hu dichtiv (Shemot 19:5) vihyitem li segulla mikkol haammim.

(Bamidbar 2:17) vennasa ohel moed machane halleviyyim vegomer. levatar ma ketiv, venasa degel machane efrayim letzivotam yamma. hayeynu shechina sheruya bemmaarav, veokmuha. ketiv (Bereshit 48:20) vayvarachem bayom hahu lemor becha yevarech yisrael lemor vegomer. vayyasem et efrayim vegomer. becha yevarech yisrael, yisrael sava. may ka mashma lan.

Ella becha yitbarech yisrael la ketiv, o becha yevorach yisrael, mahu yevarech yisrael. ella, yisrael kaddisha la yevarech lealma, ella becha, deant bemmaarav. uchetiv (Bereshit 35:11) ani el shadday pere ureve. olifna dechama immeh shechinta, ucheden amar becha yevarech yisrael lemor. becha yevarech lealma.

Veheach chama, vehakketiv (Bereshit 48:10) veene yisrael kavdu mizzoken vegomer. ella sikkel et yadav ketiv. may sikkel. ella yemina hava zakif, vesate leh shechinta kelappe efrayim, vearach recha dishchinta al resheh, keden amar becha yevarech yisrael. vechama deihu lemaarav.

Vadday shechinta bemmaarav, veha okimna begin deliheve ben tzafon ledarom, uleitchabbera begufa, ulemehevi beziuuga chad. vetzafon mekabbela lah techot resha, vedarom mechabbeka lah, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. veha okimna vadday, mittato shellishlomo ben tzafon ledarom, uleitchabbera begufa, ucheden kelala chad leitbarcha alma. tenan, kol haomer tehilla ledavid 3 peamim bechol yoma, muvetach lo shehu ben haolam habba,
1270: Veha okimna begin lezavvevga lah lehay tehilla, uleishtakkecha bechol yoma ben tzafon ledarom.

Ate bar nash betzafra, mekabbel aleh ol malchut shamayim (kema deittemar misseder shevacha) beinnun tushebchan dekaamar (im) tehilla ledavid, vechullehu haleluyah deinnun siddura daasra tushebchan, daasra kitrin kaddishin dishma kaddisha. uvegin kach asra innun haleluyah. levatar siyyem baasra tushebchan, deinnun (Tehillim 150:1) haleluyah halelu el bekadsho vegomer. haleluhu vegomer. man innun asra haleluyah, veha chamishsha innun. ella share shevacha behaleluyah, vesiyyem behaleluyah.

Levatar illuya desiddur shevacha, beaz yashir moshe, deit beh kolla. uveda mekabbel aleh ol malchuta kaddisha. levatar ashre le bechesed, besiuma ditzlota, leitkaddesha beh. levatar bitzlota demincha digvura talyay, vedina share. ishtechach bechol daroma (sefer acher yoma) da mitta deityehivat ben tzafon ledarom. leitchabbera beziuuga da begufa kedka yaut. uman dimsadder umechabber lah bechol yoma kehay gavvna, vadday hu ben holam habba.

Begin kach hay degel machane efrayim yamma, veihu ben tzafon ledarom. darom reuven min sitra chad, dichtiv degel machane reuven temana. tzafon dan missitra achara, dichtiv degel machane dan tzafona. efrayim, ben da leda. ishtechach maarav deihu efrayim, ben tzafon ledarom, kolla kegavvna dilella.

Raza leyatve deroma achuna. vehachi shadar lon achuna, missitra debutzinin (sefer acher mesaddere butzinin) berazin ketirin, devaitu leyachada yichuda betufesra dekitra illaa, kabbilu alayychu ol malchuta kaddisha bechol yoma bekadmita, uveda taalun (sefer acher bekishshura) bekisura (sefer acher bekistera) kaddisha dedarom, veascharu sitre alma, ad demitkashsheran bekitura chada, uvedarom tekifu (sefer acher takeyav) ducheta, vetamman tishrun.

Ribbi elazar shail lerabbi shimon avoy, amar leh, simana leziuuga deyichuda minnayin. amar leh beri, af al gav deokimna millin lechol setar usetar, veitbadaru hacha milla vehacha milla simana da nekot bidach, vehachi hu, keen sachara demadbecha, ditnan, uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit, mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit. amar leh veha la yachil ad dimkabbal aleh bar nash ol malchuta kaddisha bekadmita, veyahiv aleh ol da, veat amrat deyete ledarom bekadmita.

Amar leh, kolla ha amena lach, deha uva lo lekeren, amena bekadmita, veha yadata raza dekeren, veda hu ol malchuta kaddisha. levatar deromit mizrachit, detamman hu ilana dechayye. veda leizdavvevga leh bemizrach deihu abba illaa. deha ben missitra deabba ka ate. uvegin kach, middarom lemizrach, detukepa dedarom bemizrach hu, uvae leitkashshera kachada, darom bemizrach.

Umizrach deitkeshar betztzafon, (kema deat amar 0 vatzepavenach temalle vitnam) begin dehay ashlim umalle nachalin umabbuin, veal da mizrachit tzefonit, illen abba veima dela mitparshan lealmin, veha okimna. uma deittemar tzefonit, deihu temira illaa, umistar dilah nafik tzafon, vedinin missitra dilah mitarin, af al gav dehi rachame vechedu. veha okimna. vechad ihi nafkat, tzafon nafkat beh, deihu itkelil veitkeshar badarom.

Levatar tzefonit maaravit, deha missitra deabba nafik ben, umissitra deima nefikat bat. uvegin kach tzefonit maaravit, veda hu keren dekadmeta, (65 amud alef) dehashta itkeshar batztzafon setam. levatar bae lekashshera lah badarom, detamman hu kishshura decholla, vegufa beh ishtechach, veal da maaravit deromit.

Ishtechach hay keren 3 zimnin, chad lekabbela leh bar nash bekadmita, ulevatar hachi lekashshera lah bitre deroe, leitchabbera begufa, ulemehevi kolla chad. veda hu siddura deyichuda shelim. vechol setar usetar behahu kishshura deitchaze leh, vela yachlif sitra besitra achara dela itchaze leh, begin dela yitanash. man deavid
1271: Yichuda da kadka chaze kema daamena, zakkaa chulakeh behay alma uvealma deate, deha yada lesaddera shevacha demareh, veyichuda demareh, vela od ella dekudesha berich hu mishtebach beh. aleh ketiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Ribbi shimon patach (Tehillim 25:1-2) ledavid elecha Adonai nafshi essa elohay becha vatachti vegomer, may ka chama david lesaddera hay shevacha hachi. vechullehu shevache deinnun bealfa beta kullehu shelemin, vehay chasra dela it beh 6. vaamay siddura da leminpal al anpin.

Ella (401 chaze) raza illaa hu, ganiz ben chavrayyay. beshaata delelya al, (veshalta) ilana tattaa detalyay beh mota parish anpoy umechasseya lecholla. veal da itchashach. vechol bene alma taamin taama demota, veakdim bar nash veyahiv leh pikdona denafsheh, veafkedeh bideh befikdona. uvegin denatil lon befikdona, tav pikdona lemareh beshaata deate tzafra. kad ate tzafra vetav legabbeh pikdoneh, bae levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, deihu mehemana illaa.

Levatar dekam, al leve kenishta, mittar betotfe. itkesse bechisuy detzitzit. al umadke garmeh bekurebnin bekadmita. levatar kabbil aleh ol malchuta besiddura dishvache dedavid, deinnun siddura deol malchuta. uvesiddura dishvacha da, ashra aleh hahu ol. levatar siddura ditzlota dimyushav, utzelota dimumad, lekashshera lon kachada.

Ta chaze raza demilla af al gav ditzlota talyay bemillula vedibbura defuma, kolla talyay beikara deovada bekadmita, ulevatar bedibbura uvemillula defuma. man ovada, ella hahu ovada deavid bar nash bekadmita, kegavvna ditzlota hu, vela yitzle bar nash tzelota, ad deyitchaze ovada bekadmita kegavvna ditzlota. (Shemot 201 amud bet)

Ovada dekadmeta (sefer acher bekadmita ovada) beshaata devar nash kaim, bae ledakkea garmeh bekadmita. ulevatar yekabbel aleh hay ol, lefarsa al resheh perisu demitzva. levatar yitkeshar kishshura deyichuda deinnun tefillin, (mahu tefillin) tefilla shel rosh, veshel yad. uleatkena lon bekishshura chada bismala, veal libba, kema deokimna (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vegomer. uchetiv (Shir HaShirim 8:6) simeni chachotam al libbecha kachotam al zeroecha. veha okimna. veda hu ovada bekadmita.

Levatar beshaata debar nash al leve kenishta, yidke garmeh bekadmita, bekarbenin, bemillula defuma. levatar yekabbel aleh hay ol malchut, lefarsa al resheh (perishu demitzva) beshivche dedavid malka. kegavvna deovada defaris al resheh perisu demitzva. ulevatar tzelota dimyushav, lokovel tefilla shel yad. levatar tzelota dimumad, dehi lokovel tefilla deresha. veda kegavvna deda. ovada kegavvna dedibbura. vadday beovada umillula talyay tzelota.

Vei pagim ovada, millula la ashkach atar desharya beh, velav ihu tzelota, veitpegim hahu bar nash leella vetatta. (velo od ella) devaenan leachazaa ovada, ulemallela millula aleh, veda hu tzelota shelim. vavy leh levar nash defagim tzeloteh, pulechana demareh. aleh ketiv, (Yeshayahu 1:15) ki tavou leraot panay vegomer. gam ki tarbu tefilla enenni shomea, deha beovada uvemillula talya milleta.

Ta chaze, kevan devar nash avid tzelota kegavvna da, beovada uvemillula, vekashir kishshura deyichuda, ishtechach deal yedeh mitbarchan illain vetattain. keden bae leh levar nash leachazaa garmeh, batar desiyyem tzelota daamida, keillu itpetar min alma, deha itperash min ilana dechayye, vechanish ragloy legabbe hahu ilana demota, deahadar leh pikdoneh. kema deat amer (Bereshit 49:33) vayyeesof raglav el hammitta. deha ode chetoy, vetzalle alayyhu. hasheta bae leitkannesha legabbe hahu ilana demota, uleminpal, velema legabbeh elecha Adonai nafshi essa. bekadmita,
1272: Yahivna lach befikdona, hasheta dekashirna yichuda, veavedna ovada umillula kedka yeot, veodena al chataay, ha nafshi masirna lach vadday.

Veyecheze bar nash garmeh keillu patir min alma, denafsheh masir lehay atar demota, begin kach la it beh vav, devav ilana dechayye hu, vehay ilana demota hu. veha ka mashma lan, deraza demilla, (may ka mashma lan raza demilla) deit chovin dela mitkapperan, ad deitpetar bar nash mealma, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 22:14) im yechuppar heavon hazze lachem ad temutun, vehay yahiv garmeh vadday lemota, umasir nafsheh lehay atar. lav befikdona kema belelya, ella keman deitpetar min alma vadday.

Vetikkuna da bae bechavvavna delibba ucheden kudesha berich hu merachem aloy, umechapper leh lechoveh. zakkaa hu bar nash deyada lemippete leh, ulemiflach lemareh, biruta uvechavvavna delibba. vavy leh leman deate lemifte lemareh, belibba rechika, vela biruta. kema deat amer (Tehillim 78:36-37) vayfattuhu befihem uvilshonam yechazzevu lo velibbam lo nachon immo. hu omer (Tehillim 25:1) elecha Adonai nafshi essa, velav kol milloy ella belibba rechika, ha garam aleh leistalleka mealma, ad la matun yomoy, bezimna deha ilana ittear bealma lemebad dina.

Veal da bae bar nash leadbeka nafsheh ureuteh bemareh, vela yete legabbeh biruta kediva, begin dichtiv, (Tehillim 101:7) dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay. may lo yikkon. ella beshaata dehu atkin garmeh lehay, velibbeh rechika mikudesha berich hu, kala nafik veamar, lo yikkon leneged enay. (amay) hay bae leatkena garmeh, lo yikkon, la baena deyittakkan. kol shekken i ate leyachada shema kaddisha, vela meyached leh kedka yeot.

Zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayya bealma den uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 66:18) uvau verau et chevodi vegomer. uchetiv, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha vegomer. ata ribbi elazar venashik yedoy. amar, ilmale la atena lealma ella lemishma millin illen dayay. amar ribbi yehuda, zakkaa chulakana, vezakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, deinnun mitdabbekin bekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim vegomer. (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim vegomer. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen
1273: Keden karoza kare bealma, deha iddan hu leitteara leshabbecha leh lemalka. ucheden tushebchan mitarin, veitbassemuta decholla ishtechach. zakkaa chulakeh man deittear lezavvevga ziuuga da. kad ate tzafra, vimina ittear umechabbeka lah, keden ziuuga decholla ishtechach kachada. (sefer acher lemalka, kad ate tzafra vimina ittear vamechabek la keden ziuuga decholla ishtechach kachada ucheden taveshabechaten mitarin veitbassemuta decholla ishtechach zakkaa chulakeh man deittear lezavvevga ziuuga da)

Ta chaze, beshaata divne nasha demichin, vetaamin taama demota, venishmeta salleka leella, kayyeyma baatar dekayyeyma, veitbechinat al ovadaha deavdat kol yoma, vechatvin lehu al pitka. may tama. begin denishmeta salleka leella, veashidat al ovadoy debar nash, veal kol milla umilla denafik mippumeh.

Vechad hahi milla deappik bar nash mippumeh ihi kedka yaut, milla kaddisha deorayyta utzelota. hahi milla salleka, uvaka rekiin, vekayyeyma beatar dekayyeyma, ad deal lelya, venishmeta salleka veachid lehahi milla, veail lah kamme malka.

Vechad hahi milla lav ihi kedka yaut, veihi milla mimmilin bishin, millishana bisha, hahi milla salleka laatar desalleka, ucheden itreshim hahi milla, vehahu chova aleh debar nash, hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:Adonai) mishshochevet chekecha shemor pitche picha. uvegin kach (Tehillim 32:2) ashre adam lo yachashov Adonai lo avon. ematay. kesheen berucho remiyya.

Raya mehemna (Bamidbar 4:47) mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben chamishshim shana kol habba laavod avodat avoda vaavodat massa beohel moed. pikkuda da lihyot halleviyyim meshorrim bamikdash. veaf al gav deokimna leella, hacha tzarich lechaddesh millin, deha kohen ihu makriv karbena, veihu michael. levi ihu gavriel. ihu tzarich lenaggena.

Veraza demilla, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetztzavve Adonai chasdo, da chesed kahana rabba demichael ihu kohen hedyot legabbe mareh, veim kol da dehedyot ihu etztzel mareh. melech dechayyot hakkodesh ihu. uvirkat hedyot al tehi kala beenecha, vehay ihu yomam yetztzavve Adonai chasdo.

Uvallayla shiro immi, da gevura. shiro: (Devarim 33:17) bechor shoro hadar lo. (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene shor mehassemol, vegavriel shelucheh, vetztzarich leshorer ulenaggen bechedva bechamra deorayyta, (leitasseka leshalacha karbena kamme malka bechedva uman delet leh reshu) leitasseka beorayyta, yekayyem (Eicha 2:19) kumi ronni vallayla lerosh ashmurot.

Veyemma beashmurot, kama selichot vetachanunim uvakkashot, bechol mine rinna bigroneh, deihu kinnor leappaka beh kala, beshit kanfe rea im vavrda. beshit izkan dekane. veda 6. veyippuk leh millibba, detamman bina. kema deukemuha mare matnitin, hallev mevin. yippuk ben mibbina, mibben yah, deihu 6, deihu efroach beshit gadpin. visallek leh beshit izkan dekane, deinnun (Melachim 1 10:19) shesh maalot lakkisse.

8 Kurseyayn innun (Yirmeyahu 17:12) kisse chavod marom merishon, veinnun libba ufuma. lev, (Shemot 17:16) vayyomer ki yad al kes yah milchama laAdonai baamalek, (257) kaved, samael, puma dechisse, kes 15, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 81:4) tiku vachodesh shofar vegomer.

May shofar. kane, 6, kol desalik min hakkane, legabbe puma, detamman Adonai. baAdonai mine tikkunin dedibbura, deinnun sifvavn veshinayim vechech. sifvavn teren. shinayim vetochanot teren minin. vechech, ha chamesh. detachanin kenahar deihu kol, kegavvna detachanin rechayay. leappaka kol vedibbur, denafik mibbina delibba. bemachashava.

Deihu shema meforash beeser mine tillim. uveshofar, en pochatin measara shofarot. veorayyta, kala dilah, dibbur dilah, bina dilah, deukemuha ezhu chacham hammevin davar mittoch davar. machashava dileh. chashiv kame kudesha berich hu, mikkol karbenin veillavavn, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 7:37) zot hattora leola velammincha. (ad kan raya mehemana) (24 amud bet pikkuda da hammoel behekdesh vechulei)

(Bamidbar Adonai:6) ish o isha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam vegomer. ta chaze, ketiv (Shoftim 4:11) vechever hakkeni nifrad mikkayin mibbene chovav choten moshe vegomer, vechever hakkeni mibbene benoy deyitro hava, kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 15:6) vayyomer shaul el hakkeni vegomer. amay ikre keni. veha ukemuha. uchetiv (Bereshit 15:19) et hakkeni veet hakkenizzi. veittemar deavad kinna bemadbera, keofa da, begin lemile beorayyta, veitperash min mata, nifrad mikkayin, itperash mehahu amma dehava bekadmita, veitdabbak beh bekudesha berich hu, nifrad mikkayin.
Zakkaa bar nash dezache beorayyta, lemezal leitdabbeka beorchoy. dechad bar nash azil
1274: Beorchoy deorayyta, mashich aleh rucha kaddisha illaa. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 32:15) ad yeare alenu ruach mimmarom. vechad bar nash sate orchoy, mashich aleh rucha achara missitra achara, dehu sitra demisava. vesitra demisava ittear missitra denukeba dithoma rabba, detamman madorin deruchin bishin, denazke livne nasha, deikrun nazkke alma. deha (143 amud alef amud bet) missitra dekayin kadmaa ishtechachu.

Veyitro bekadmita kumara leavoda zara hava, ulehahu setar hava palach, umashich aleh rucha mehahu atar. veal da ikre keni levatar nifrad mikkayin (vadday), veitdevak (nusach acher veitchabbar) beh bekudesha berich hu, (may mashma) dechol man deitdabbak beh bekudesha berich hu, veavid pikkude orayyta, kivyachol, hu kiyyem almin, alma dilella vealma diltatta. veha ukemuha, vaasitem otam ketiv.

Vechol man deavar al pikkude orayyta, kivyachol pagim leella, pagim letatta, pagim legarmeh, pagim lechol almin. metal leinnun mafreshe yamin deshate (sefer acher datesareyn) bearba, kam chad shatyay benayyhu, baa lenakva vechulei.

Veal da ish o isha ki yaasu vegomer, haadam vegomer. (401 chaze) (Hoshea 6:7) vehema keadam avru verit. adam avar al pikkuda chad deorayyta, garim leh legarmeh mita, vegaram lechol alma, pagim leella, pagim letatta, vehahu chova talyay, ad dikayyem kudesha berich hu alma kemillekaddemin, veyitavar hahu pegimu mealma, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavt lanetzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim vegomer. uvegin kach ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam. (ketiv) haadam, adam kadmaa.

Limol maal baAdonai, deman deyippuk merachame, veyanka min dina, hu garim pegimu vechulei, veal da, rachamana lishezvan mechayayve dehay alma, umin pegimu dilhon, kama zakkain mistalleke beginayyhu, bar kol ma degarme leella vetatta.

Ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda havo azle meusha lelud, amar ribbi yehuda (yitzchak) nema millin deorayyta venezil. patach ribbi yehuda (sefer acher yitzchak) veamar, (Shemot 21:33) ki yiftach ish bor o ki yichre ish bor vegomer. ma ketiv batreh, baal habbor yeshallem vegomer. uma al da kach, man degarim leavasha alma bechovoy al achat kamma vechamma. ella tavvavhna deaf al gav deavish alma, amay it leh teshuva, kema dichtiv ish o isha ki yaasu vegomer vehitvaddu et chattatam veheshiv.

Ella vadday da mehaneya lehu, begin deavid teshuva, kivyachol hu avid leh mammash. deha ma defagim leella, atkin leh, uvema bitshuva. dichtiv ish o ishsha ki yaasu vegomer, vehitvaddu et chattatam veheshiv, uteshuva atkin kolla, atkin leella, atkin letatta, atkin legarmeh, atkin lechol alma.

Patach ribbi yitzchak (sefer acher yehuda) abbatreh veamar, (Devarim 4:30) batztzar lecha umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle vegomer. batztzar lecha, mikkan ditshuva mealleya mikkolla, ad la yishre dina bealma. devatar dishre dina takkif cheleh man yabar leh mealma visallek leh. deha

Raya mehemna pikkuda da, hi mitztzevat teshuva. veda ihi bina. uvaavonotenu middecharav be makdesha, la ishtear lanu ella vduy devarim levad, veda malchut. umay bina. ben yah. vehay ben, 6 ihu vadday. vechol man dechazar betiyyuveta, keillu chazar at Adonai leat 6, deihu ben yah, veishtelim beh Adonai. veda ihu teshuva, tashuv Adonai vadday legabbe 6.

Deat Adonai vadday ihu vidduy devarim, veraza demilla, (Hoshea 14:3) kechu immachem devarim veshuvu el Adonai imru elav vegomer uneshallema parim sefatenu. devadday kad bar nash ihu chote, garim leitrachaka Adonai meat 6. deistellak ben yah, da Yahu, meat Adonai. uvegin da itcharav be makdesha, veitrachaku yisrael mittamman, veitgelu bene amamya. uvegin da, kol man deavid teshuva, garim leachzera Adonai leat 6, ufurekana beda talyay. uvegin da hakkol taluy bitshuva. dechach amru kadmae, kol hakkitztzim kalu, veen haddavar taluy ella bitshuva, deihu shelimu dishmeh.
Veal da (Yechezkel 20:14) vaeese lemaan shemi. veod (Yeshayahu 48:11) lemaani lemaani eese. veim lav chazrin, ana aamid lon malka, shekashin gezirotav mishshel paro, veyachzerun al karchayyeyhu.
1275: Kevan deshari dina, la istelik ad deyishtelim. batar deishtelim, veavad teshuva, atkin almin kullehu. mashma, dichtiv umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle beacharit hayyamim, uchetiv veshavta ad Adonai elohecha vegomer. ki el rachum Adonai elohecha vegomer.

Beacharit hayyamim, may ikka hacha. ella leachlela keneset yisrael, deihi begaluta, veishtechachat beaku dilhon, vela shavkat lon lealmin. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu af al gav deashre dina bealma, bae deyahadrun yisrael bitshuva, leotava lehu behay alma, uvealma deate, velet lacha man dekaim kamme teshuva.

Ta chaze, afillu keneset yisrael, teshuva ikre. vei tema (teshuva) illaa (sefer acher mealleya) (nusach acher veet illaa) mikkol atar la shechiach, ella da ikre teshuva, kad ahdar rachame lekavlaha, vehi tavat al kol innun ochlosin veyanka lon. uteshuva mealya, kad itmesar nafsha legabbah, venatil lah bezimna deihi bitshuva, keden kolla ittakkan leella vetatta, veittakkan hu, vechol alma.

Chayyayva chad bealma, kilkula dechamma acharanin begineh. vavy lachayyayva, vavy lishviveh. ta chaze, yona, begin dela baa lemehach bishlichuta demareh, kama bene nasha havo itavidu begineh beyamma, ad dechullehu ahadru aloy, vedainu leh bedina beyamma, ucheden ishtezivu kullehu, vekudesha berich hu chas aleh levatar, vesheziv kama ochlosin bealma. ematay. kad ahdar lemareh miggo akteh. hada hu dichtiv, (Yona 2:3) karati mitztzara li el Adonai vayyaaneni. uchetiv, (Tehillim 118:5) min hammetzar karati yah anani vamerchav yah vegomer.
Hada hu dichtiv veshavta ad Adonai elohecha, ad Adonai vadday.

Uteshuva da itkeriat chayyim, (Mishlei 4:23) ki mimmennu totztzeot chayyim, deinnun nishmatin deyisrael. veihu hevel denafak veal befuma debar nash, belo amal uvelo yegia. Adonai dibbehibbaram. vealah ittemar, (Devarim 8:3) ki al kol motztza pi Adonai yichye haadam. vehi al resheh debar nash. ala ittemar, (Bamidbar 12:8) utemunat Adonai yabbit. (Tehillim 39:7) ach betztzelem yithallech ish.
Uvegin deihi al resheh debar nash, asir leh lebar nash lemezal 4 ammot begiluy deresha, deem hi istalakat meal resheh debar nash, miyyad istelaku chayyim minneh.

Vei tema dechach sharya al umin dealma, af al gav dela itbere behon shemaya veara vechol toladin divhon. la sharya vadday, demoshe baa mikudesha berich hu, dela tishre shechina al umin dealma, veyahiv leh. havla dekayyeyma al umin dealma mean nafka. o al chayyayvayya deinnun erev rav meuravin im yisrael. ella vadday let kol appayay shavin, afillu yisrael lav innun shavyan, kol shekken acharanin.

Ella vadday al hay diyyukena deat Adonai ukemuha, mattana tova yish li bevet genazay veshabbat shemah. vechad hay sharya al yisrael, let lon yegia vela shibud. uva nefesh amela vigea (Shemot 31:17) shavat vayyinnafash.

Denefesh achara it al resheh debar nash, deitkeriat eved. veihu diyyukena al bar nash. veihi eved demalka, dimnanea kol evarin debar nash, lemezal bearchin tavin, ulekayyeyma behon 248 pikudin, lesharya alayyhu Adonai dibbehibbaram, dechach salik hibbaram lermch.

Udeyukena achara al resheh, deitkeriat yira, veda 10. vealayyhu ittemar, (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betztzalmo betztzelem elohim. teren diukenin tavin, deinnun dechar venukeba. dechar missitra deat 10. nukeba missitra deat Adonai.

Uteren atvavn attearin leh lebar nash lattora velammitztzeva. 10 yira, veda ihi al resheh debar nash, uminah yeul dechilu lelibba debar nash, lemidchal mekudesha berich hu, ulenatra garmeh dela yevar al pikudin dela taase. Adonai ahava al resheh debar nash, uminneh al rechimu dekudesha berich hu, al 248 evarin dileh, lekayyeyma behon pikudin daase. 6 ihi al resheh debar nash, uminneh yiul al puma debar nash milulin leolfa beorayyta.
Uvehay kechu immachem devarim veshuvu el Adonai. uvehay diyhe bechon hayyira vehaahava vehattora yitchazir Adonai deihu bina teshuva, 6 tashuv legabbe Adonai, deihu ovada divreshit. veihi 32 elohim.
1276: Veyishtelim yedod uva yehe lechon nayycha mikkolla, uvah shavat vayyinnafash.

Uvah yitkelil 20, uvegin da vaychullu: shelimu decholla. bah, itbere kol alma, vealah kayymin shemaya veara veyamma vechol biryayn deitberun, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, baAdonai beraam. veim hi itrachakat mealma afillu riga, kolla itcharev veitbatel, vela havi kiuma bealma.

Hay Adonai la tezil miggufa, uvah kayyma vechad hi tezil minneh, hu sam hammavt tete vetishre aleh, detitkere tumea, nevela, pesula, malach hammavt, choshech, afella, vesharya al gufa debar nash. uvehahu zimna itkere bar nash met. veraza demilla, (Yechezkel 18:32) ki lo echpotz bemot hammet neum Adonai elohim vehashivu vichyu.

Kol pikudin daase, dahavo atidin lesharya bermch evarin dileh, kullehu mitabbelin aleh. veraza demilla, (Yeshayahu 57:18) derachav raiti veerpaehu vegomer. velaavelav. may velaavelav. illen 248 evarin, deka mitabbelin aleh, deinnun diyyukena illaa desharya al resheh, devah sharya havaya. dichma deit (vayyishlach 165, Shemot 106 amud bet) diyyukena tava al tzaddik, umanhig leh lechol ovadin tavin, lezakkaa leh lealma deate. kach it diyyukena bisha, al resha dechayyayvayya, leanhaga lon beovadin bishin, deyartun gehinnam. uvegin da it hevel veit hevel, it hevel tav, deittemar beh, (Devarim 8:3) ki al kol motztza fi Adonai yichye haadam. veit hevel bish, deittemar beh (Kohelet 2:26) gam ze hevel ureut ruach.

Veta chaze beovadin debar nash ishtemoda partztzufa, deihi aleh, ufartztzufa deanpoy. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:9) hakkarat penehem anta bam. bediyyukena, ishtemoda partztzufa dechayya desharya aleh, im hu aryi, o shor o nesher, o adam. mehammerkava dekudesha berich hu ushechinteh. o mehammerkava demalach sar happanim. o mehammerkava bisha desamael. o mehammerkava dearba yesodin dealma. velet behon la hayitztzer tov, vela hayitztzer hara, ella kivirin dealma. uvegin da kama havalim it bivne nasha, kol chad lemineh. veraza demilla, (Bereshit 1:24) totztze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah. uvegin da, bemmidda sheadam moded bah moddin lo. uvechol partztzufa it memana aleh.

Ta chazi, leshit yome bereshit, lechol chad it leh partztzufeh, dehahu darga deanhig leh, vela tishkach yom delet beh tov. veaf al gav divyoma tinyayna la it beh tov, beyoma telitaa tishkach leh. uvegin da ittemar beh tere zimne tov.

Vechol yoma it leh gader millevar, dela yiul kol bar nash lehahu tov. kegon choshech dechasse linhora. detishkach beyoma kadmaa or, vetishkach beh choshech. bechol yoma tishkach netira. veinnun netirin innun, kegon kotztzim lakkerem. veit netirin acharanin, kegon nechashim veakrabbim userafim, venatrin hahu tov, dela yiul tamman delav ihu rauy lemeal. vei lav, kol chayyayvayya havo alin berazin deorayyta.

Uvegin da man deihu chayayva, veyiul leminda razin deorayyta, kama malache chabbala deitkeriu choshech vaafela, nechashim veakrabbim chevat bara itkeriu, umevalbelin machashavteh, dela yiul laatar delav dileh.

Aval man deihu tov, kol illen netirin innun lememreh, vekategor neesa sanegor, veyialun (leh) letov haganuz, veyemrun leh marana, ha bar nash tov vetztzaddik yere shamayim, bae leaala kodamach, amar lanu, (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek avo vam ode yah. hahu tov haganuz yimma lon, pitchu leh behay tara deitkere ahava, o behay tara deihi teshuva. kol tzaddik yiul kefum darga dileh, veraza demilla (Yeshayahu 26:2) pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik vegomer.

Kean tzarich leahaddera al petach hatteshuva. vechi mikkamma minin ihu teshuva deavdin bene nasha, kullehu tavin, aval lav kol appayay shavin. it bar nash deihu rasha gamur kol yamav, veihu over al kama pikudin dela taase, umitcharet umode alayyhu, ulevatar ken la aved la tav vela bish. leda vadday yimchol leh kudesha berich hu, aval la deyizke litshuva illaa. it bar nash levatar deyetuv mechataav, umitkapper leh, ihu azil bederech mitztzeva, umitassek bechol kocho bidchilu urechimu dekudesha berich hu. da zache litshuva tattaa, deitkere Adonai. veda ihu teshuva tattaa.

Veit bar nash levatar demitcharet mechovoy, veyavid teshuva, veyitasak beorayyta bidchilu urechimu dekudesha berich hu, vela al menat lekabbel peras. da zache leat 6, veihu ben yah, veal shemeh itkere bina, veda garim detashuv 6 legabbe Adonai. umillat teshuva kach hi, tashuv 6 laAdonai.
Uleolam la sharya Adonai bevar nash, velo 6,
1277: Bela dechilu uvela rechimu, deinnun yah, yira veahava karenan leh vadday. umittamman ityeyhivu hattora vehammitztzeva deinnun ben uvat. uvegin deyisrael mekayyeymin hattora vehammitztzeva, itkeriu banim lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem.

Hannistarot: yira veahava, deinnun bemocha velibba. bachalala degufa. uveresha. vehanniglot: hattora vehammitztzeva, deinnun begufa uveresha levar. veraza demilla hachi hu vadday, dei bar nash dachil lekudesha berich hu, o rachim leh, da la yada bar nash achara, begin deihu milla dela itgalya ella beno leven kono.

Aval bar nash demitasak beorayyta, veazil befikkudin daase, da itgalya lechol bar nash, begin dekudesha berich hu aved leh puma beitgalya, leitasseka beorayyta, veayynin leistakkela bah, veudenin lemishma bah. veavid kudesha berich hu bebar nash, yedin veraglin vegufa, lemebad behon pikudin dease.

Im ken chotama lemay nafka minneh. (Bereshit 2:7) vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim, da ihi diyyukena deal bar nash, deittemar beh (Bereshit 28:12) vayachalom vehinne sullam. sullam vadday ihi nishmat chayyim, kurseyay leshem Adonai deihu hayyira vehaahava hattora vehammitztzeva uva sharya, vehay kurseyay, minnah gezurot kol nishmatin deyisrael, veihi diyyukena al resha debar nash.

Vehinne malache elohim olim veyordim bo. illen havalim desallekin venafkin begufa, behay sullam. ihu chad, sheviaa decholla. veihu mutztzav artztza, teren. verosho maggia hashshamayma, telat. vehinne malache elohim olim, tere. veyordim tere. innun lokovel 4 ruchot vehashshamayim vehaaretz. veraza, demilla (Kohelet 1:2) havel havalim amar kohelet havel havalim hakkol havel. innun shiva, lokovel kuresyay, deihu hassullam, vehashshamayim vehaaretz, ved yesodin dealma, veinnun shiva. lokovel shiva yome bereshit. it kol biryayn dishmayya, veyamma, veara. kegon chayot ofot behemot dagim, vechamma toladin detalyayn minneh.

Uvegin decholla itbere behay tzulema, deal kol yisrael deihi tzaddik, ittemar behon (Bereshit 9:2) umoraachem vechittechem yihye al kol chayyat haaretz veal kol of hashshamayim vegomer. veda memallel al bene nasha, deinnun metilin lechevan bara, veliviran, uleofin, ulenune yamma. deit bar nash demazzaleh shor, umazzaleh aryi, umazzaleh nesher, umazzaleh adam.

Vechol illen, lamma mitpachadin mehay diyyukena deinnun mittamman itberiu. ella mishshum deshem Adonai sharya aleh. raza demilla, (Devarim 28:10) verau kol amme haaretz vegomer. vechol man defagim ovadoy, itpegim diyyukeneh. veshem Adonai la sharya baatar pagim, uvehahu pegimu sharya choshech, begin pegimu desihara desharya beh chashocha. vehay bar nash kema deihu pagim diyyukeneh, kach itpegim ihu letatta, o itavid illem, o cheresh, o suma, o chigger. begin diyyehe rashim leella vetatta.

Vehahu choshech sharya bifgimu dileh, umiyyad ishtemodan beh dargin kaddishin, deinnun cheloy dekudesha berich hu, umitrachakin minneh, dichvar yadin divhahu pegimu la sharya malka. uvegin da cheloy demalka mitrachakin minneh, dechayyaylin demalka la sharyayn, vela mitkarvan, ella beatar demalka sharya, dechach innun mitnahagin abbatreh, keevarin batar gufa.

Uvehahu atar deshare hahu choshech, kama malache chabbala, deitkeriu nechashim veakrabbim, mitkarvin leh, veyahavin leh kama neshichin, veillen innun yissurin. vei it leh mamona deovadin tavin deavid, itmaatun minneh. veech itmaatun minneh, ella kol zechut denachit leh milella, yahiv leh leillen malache chabbala, uvatlin minneh yisurin. vei leh leh zechu, vela chova leella, ella kolla letatta, bechol zechu deavid nachit leh mamonin, veumin dealma mitkarvin leh, lokovel malache chabbala, veyahiv lon mamona, veishteziv minnayyhu.

Uvegin da havo yisrael mekarvin laazazil, legabbe hahu choshech. veshivim parim, lokovel shivim umin, lekayyeyma kera, (Mishlei 25:21) im raev sonaacha haachilehu lachem veim tzame hashekehu mayim. umiyyad dehadrin betiyyuveta, itabbar hahu choshech mehahu pegimu, veyishtelim. veraza demilla, (Shmuel 2 12:13) gam Adonai heevir chatatcha lo tamut. umiyyad ithaddar beh shema daAdonai, veitterae (nusach acher vaytarepay) beh, meinnun neshichin deyisurin, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 6:10) veshav verafa lo. uminnayin deithaddar kudesha berich hu miyyad dehadar betiyyuveta veishtelim hahu pegimu. hada hu dichtiv, (Malachi 3:7) shuvu elay veashuva alechem.
Veda ihu bitshuva gemura, degarim leahaddera bina deihu 20, legabbe Adonai deihi malchut. deazla menaddeda min
1278: Kinaha, deihi hahi diyyukena, demitkatrin bah kol pikudin. uvah mitkatrin eser sefiran. kad bar nash aved pikkuda chada vela yattir, veavid lah bidchilu urechimu dekudesha berich hu. beginah sharyayn aleh 10 sefiran. vechol man dekiyyem pikkuda chad kadka yaut, keillu mekayyem 248 pikkudin daase, delet pikkuda delav ihu kelila mikkullehu 248. (ad kan raya mehemana).

(Bamidbar Adonai:12) ish ish ki tiste ishto vegomer. may hay legabbe hay. ella kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar Adonai:12) limol maal baAdonai. ribbi elazar amar, ish ish, may ish ish, deha bechad sagge, ella ha okmuha, aval ish ish, mashma ish deihu ish, vekiyyem kera dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:15) shete mayim mibborecha vegomer. keden hu ish bealma, ish legabbe itteteh. umaala vo maal, ha bechad sagge, amay tere. ella chad leella vechad letatta. chad likkeneset yisrael, vechad levalah. begin kach vehevi haish et ishto.

Amay el hakkohen. raza demilla, begin dechahana shushevina ihu dematronita. hacha it leistakkela, ha ketiv (Vayikra 1:Adonai) veshachat et ben habbakar, veshachat achara, velav kahana, dechahana asir leh bedina, begin dela yafgim hahu atar deachid beh, veat amrat, vehevi haish et ishto el hakkohen, lemedan dinaha. ella vadday kahana leda chaze, begin deihu shushevina lematronita, vechol neshe alma mitbarchan (nusach acher itachadat) bikkeneset yisrael, veal da itteta diltatta mitbarcha besheva berachot, daachidat bah bichneset yisrael, vechahana kaim leatkena mille dematronita, uleayyeyna bechol ma deitzterich, begin kach kahana leda, vela achara.

Vei tema deihu avid dina, lav hachi, ella leasgaa shelama bealma ka ishtaddal behay, uleasgaa chesed. dei hahi itteta ishtechachat zakkaa, kahana asge shelama behu, velo od ella demitabbera bivra dechar, veitavid shelama al yedeh. vei la ishtechachat zakkaa, ihu la avid dina, ella hahu shema kaddisha deihi ka meshakkerat beh, hu avid dina, vehu badik lah.
Ta chaze, kahana la ayel garmeh lehay, ella kad hi yahavat garmah kammeh, mippea (nusach acher lezakkaa)

Raya mehemna eliyyahu, kum aftach ammi befikkudin, deant hu ozir li, bechol sitra. deha alach ittemar bekadmita, pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen. uven aharon vadday ihu ach dili, (Mishlei 17:17) ach letztzara yivvaled.

Patach veamar, pikkuda ladun bedine sota, hada hu dichtiv veavar alav ruach kina vekinne vegomer. vadday ruach tumea mitteren sitrin ishtechach, chad beshikra, vechad bikshot. begin da, beruach shikra vekinne et ishto, vehi lo nitmaa. vetanena, veavar alav vegomer, vekinne et ishto vehi nitmaa.

Vechi it kusheta beruach misava. ella bevar nash missitra deilana detov vara, tamman yetztzer hara, nachash. bezimna deit lebar nash itteta shappira, bechol ovadin tavin, deittemar bah (Mishlei 12:4) eshet chayil ateret balah. yitztzer hara it leh kina, kegavvna deashkachna dekanne adam al inteteh, ad defatte lah, vegaram lah mita. ulezimnin shallit alah bechovin, umesaav lah, veha itavidat nevela.

Veyitztzer hara, missitra dimina, dileh, darga deyishmael, itkere nachash. umissitra dismala, dargeh deesav samael, itkere kelev, memana degehinnam detztzooach hav hav, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 30:15) laaluka shete vanot hav hav, uviruta dileh lemechal nishmeta misava, benura dileh, gehinnam. veavar alav ruach kina vekinne et ishto bikshot, vehi nitmaa.

Uveginah ittemar, (Vayikra 21:9) uvat ish kohen, da michael, ki techel liznot et aviha hi mechallelet baesh tissaref. vetamman ittokdat hahi zuhama, veitlabbenat ihi minneh, kakkesef deitlabban benura, vehahi oferet dezuhama ittokad, veitavid afar, veitavid.

Kegavvna da beyisrael, kad innun mechallelin orayyta, kudesha berich hu yeul lon begaluta divne esav uvene yishmael, techot shibuda dilhon, dedargayyhu kelev venachash, veittedanu tamman, uvehon yitbarru veyitlabbenu veyitztzorfu kitztzerof hakkesef vechivchon hazzahav, hada hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 13:9) utztzeraftim kitztzerof et hakkesef uvechantim kivchon et hazzahav, ad deyitkayyem behu, (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu.
Veilana detov vara, begineh ittemar, (Shemot 15:25) vayyorehu Adonai etz vayyashlech el hammayim vayyimteku hammayim vegomer. begin dahavo yisrael im erev rav, kullehu
1279: Zimna, uteren shail lah, kevan deihi baya leishtakkecha zakkaa, keden kahana avid ovada, begin leasgaa shelama.

Kahana ketiv shema kaddisha chad zimna beorach meshar, levatar katav leh lemafrea atvavn (nusach acher sareyteyn) terisin bithirin, dina bedina, rachame berachame, rachame bedina, vedina berachame. ishtechachat zakkaa, atvavn rachame ishtechachu, vedinin sallekin. la ishtechachat kaddeka yaut, rachame sallekin, vedinin ishtearu, ucheden dina itavid.

Ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Shemot 15:23) vayavou marata velo yachlu lishtot mayim mimmara ki marim hem, ha ukemuha. amar, tavvavhna ech bene alma la mistakkelin vela mishtaddelin bemillin deorayyta, hacha it leistakkela, amay ketiv hacha sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu.

Aval vadday raza demilla, dehacha al mayyay hava, begin demitzrae havo amre, divnayyhu deyisrael havo minnayyhu, vahavu kama beyisrael dechashdin leintetayyhu beda. ad dekudesha berich hu mata lon lehay atar, uvae lemivdak lon, ma ketiv vayavou marata vegomer. veyitzak el Adonai vegomer.

Amar kudesha berich hu lemoshe, moshe ma at bae, ha kama chavilin kayymin gabbayychu hacha, vaana baena lemivdak hacha neshehon deyisrael, ketov shema kaddisha, ureme lemayyay, veyibbadkun kullehon, neshe veguverin, vela yishtear laaz al banay. vead deyibbadkun kullehu hacha, la ashre shemi alayyhu, miyyad vayyorehu Adonai etz vayyashlech el hammayim, da shema kaddisha, hahu dehava kotev kahana lemivdak neshehon deyisrael, keden, sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu.

Vei tema neshehon deyisrael yaut, innun amay. ella uf innun bayayn, dela istaavu binshehon demitzrae. uneshehon deyisrael la istaavu bemitzrae, kol innun shenin dahavo benayyhu, vechullehu nafku guverin venukevin zakkain, veishtechachu zara deyisrael kaddishin, zakkain, keden

Havo ilana detov vara, veal da, chetztzeyo matok missitra dimina. vechetztzeyo mar, missitra dismala. uvezimna deerev rav havo machatiin lon leyisrael, havi keillu havo kullehu missitra dera. umaya ithadra kullehu meririn, kehahu etz mar bemayya, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:23) vayavou marata velo yachlu lishtot mayim mimmara ki marim hem.

Vehay etz mar, ihu kegavvna denisyona desota, i satat techot balah, innun mayin deashkeyyayn lah ithadaru meririn, uvehon vetztzavta vitnah venafla yerechah, vei la satat ma ketiv, venikketa venizrea zara, veolidat bar. uf hacha vayimteku hammayim.

Kegavvna da, yitavid lenassea lon leyisrael befurekana batrayyta, hada hu dichtiv, (Daniel 12:10) yitbarru veyitlabbenu veyitztzarfu rabbim, deinnun missitra detov, vekayymin benisyona. vehirshiu reshaim innun missitra dera, veyitkayyem behon (Yechezkel 13:9) veel admat yisrael lo yavou vekatil lon.

(Daniel 12:10) vehamaskilim yavinu, missitra devina, deihu ilana dechayyi, beginayyhu ittemar, (Daniel 12:3) vehamaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia behay chibbura dilach deihu sefer hazzohar, min zohara deima illaa teshuva. beillen la tzarich nissayon, uvegin daatidin yisrael lemitam meilana dechayyi, deihu hay sefer hazzohar, yippekun beh min galuta berachame. veyitkayyem behon, (Devarim 32:12) Adonai badad yanchennu veen immo el nechar.

Veilana detov vara, deihu isur vehetter tumea vetohora, la shalta al yisrael yattir, deha parnasa dilan la lihevi, ella missitra deilana dechayyi, delet tamman la kashya missitra dera, vela machaloket meruach hatumea, dichtiv, (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hatumea aavir min haaretz.

Dela yitparnesun talmide chachamim meamme haaretz, ella missitra detov, deachlin tohora kasher hetter, vela meerev rav, deachlin tumea pasul isur, deinnun mesaavin, dimsaavin garmayyhu benidda shifcha goya zona. begin deinnun benoy delilit, deihi, nidda shifcha goya zona chazrin lesharshayhu. vealayyhu ittemar, (Yeshayahu 14:29) ki mishshoresh nachash yitztze tzefa.
Uvezimna deilana detov vara shalta, deihu chulin detahara, vechulin detumea. innun chachamim dedamyayn leshabbatot veyom tov, let lon ella ma deyahavin
